title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
description:
**About You**
-------------

We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we're open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue.  
  
XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting.  
  
You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.  
  
This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

### **About Us**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Research and discovery.** Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.
* **Coordinate the roadmap.** Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.
* **Write product requirements.** Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
* **Manage delivery.** Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
* **Track what matters.** Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.
* **Keep everyone connected.** Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

### **Requirements:**

* **Product experience.** 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.
* **Customer insight.** You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You're comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved.
* **Clear writing.** You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly.
* **Engineering partnership.** You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.
* **Cross-team communication.** You enjoy keeping people across the company informed and being a go-to resource for product questions.
* **Adaptability.** You're energized by a fast-moving, globally distributed team and comfortable making progress while the picture is still coming together.
* **Video game marketing.** You understand how games find and grow their audiences, including user acquisition, community building, and influencer campaigns. We prefer candidates with experience in the creator economy or influencer marketing.
* **Creator platform familiarity.** You know how creators work on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, or Kick, including their analytics, audience growth, and monetization tools.

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* **Marketplace or platform experience.** You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.
* **Partner commercial models.** Experience with revenue-share or performance-based partner programs.
* **Campaign attribution.** Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.
* **Data comfort.** You can pull and explore your own data with analytics tools.

Salary range based on US location only. This position is open for global remote. Salary will be determined based on location and experience.

**Benefits:**  
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**  
Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. **Who are we**

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

### **Location**

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you **must reside and have the legal right to work** in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

*This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.*

### 

### **About the Team**

We are looking for a **Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team**, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with **a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations**. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on **account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio** .

  

### **What You Will Do**

* **Own account commercial outcomes:** Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
* **Protect retention and renewal outcomes:** Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
* **Drive account expansion:** Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
* **Develop account strategies:** Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
* **Lead consultative customer conversations:** Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
* **Navigate complex enterprise sales processes:** Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
* **Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting:** Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
* **Use AI to elevate your work:** Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

  

### **What You Must Have**

* **Full account lifecycle ownership:** +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a quota-based B2B SaaS environment.
* **Proven commercial outcomes:** A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
* **Professional fluency in French**, including the ability to lead customer conversations, presentations, and commercial negotiations in French.
* Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with **experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders**, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
* Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
* Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.  

### **It's a Plus If You Have**

* Experience managing or selling to enterprise customers in the French market, regardless of where you are based.
* Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
* Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
* Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.
  

**Our Benefits**

Competitive salary and employee stock options.

Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

Health insurance to keep you covered.

Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

*We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.*

title: Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
description:
Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
=========================================

**Location:** Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

**Clients:** Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

**Reports to:** VP of Solutions

**Salary Range:** $80,000 - $150,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on acquisition and growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission
-------

Own a portfolio of client relationships. Set the strategy, keep accounts healthy and profitable, grow them, win new ones, and get the technical work delivered through the team rather than by doing it yourself.

Why this role exists
--------------------

Accounts need a senior owner accountable for whether they renew and whether they grow. Outside North America that accountability sits in the wrong time zone, so the client's executive sponsor talks to us at the end of their day and the relationship runs a meeting behind.

This is the commercial and strategic owner. It is not the technical builder.

Three problems this role solves:

* Nobody outside North America is accountable for account health, retention, and expansion.
* Executive conversations happen at inconvenient hours, so they happen less often.
* Expansion is reactive. Nobody plans the next six months before the current scope runs out, and nobody runs discovery in European hours.

Responsibilities
----------------

**Relationship ownership**

* Own the relationship at executive level. You are who the client's CMO or VP of Growth calls.
* Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews covering results, maturity, next quarter, and risks.
* Keep the client informed before they have to ask. Never surprise them on budget or timeline.

**Strategy and consulting**

* Find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Map every problem to pain, metric, impact, and fix.
* Build and defend the growth roadmap with the client, not at them.
* Do the strategic hands-on work yourself: measurement frameworks, KPI definition, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle program design, experiment roadmaps, readouts.
* Translate technical decisions into business consequences the client can act on.

**Delegation and project leadership**

* Scope the work, then hand it to architects and engineers with enough detail that it gets built right.
* Manage the project, not the build. Sprint cadence, board hygiene, dependencies, risks, critical path.
* Review delivered work against the client's objectives before it ships. You are not the QA engineer, but you are accountable for whether the client got what they were told they would get.
* Know enough to challenge an estimate and spot a bad technical answer. You do not write the code.

**New business**

* Run pre-sales discovery. Qualify hard, and say no when a prospect is not ready.
* Build and present proposals: scope, phasing, investment, and the business case. Presented live, never sent cold.
* Price work so it delivers profitably. A generous estimate at proposal is a delivery problem in month three.
* Work with Sales through qualification, discovery, and close, then take the account into delivery.

**Commercial**

* Own retention and expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on both.
* Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
* Run the six-month roadmap cycle so the next engagement is signed before the current one ends.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* 10+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 5 owning senior client relationships with a revenue number attached.
* Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, and where revenue leaks between the stages.
* Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
* Advise on the systems below: which to use, how they fit together, the tradeoffs, and how to get more from what a client already owns. You do not configure them. You do need to be right about them, and to spot a bad technical answer when you are given one.
* Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and how to leverage data to improve marketing returns.
* Track record retaining and expanding accounts, with figures a former manager would confirm.
* Pre-sales experience: discovery, scoping, writing proposals, and presenting them to executive buyers.
* Scope and price technical work profitably.
* Know how European businesses buy, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent.

**Systems.** Advisory command of these. Depth in at least three groups.

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

**Preferred**

* Accounts across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
* Work across both European and North American clients.
* Built or seeded a regional practice before.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal and expansion. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You advise on the new pattern while most of the market still sells the old one.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. That includes telling a client when they already have what they need.
* Many industries and stacks in a year instead of one in five, on both sides of the Atlantic.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded onto your accounts, each with a current-state assessment and named client objectives.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* Every account's decision-maker has met you and knows what you own.

**Month 4**

* Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, budget conversations, scope changes.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.
* Technical work delegated with specs good enough that it does not come back for rework.
* Running discovery calls and contributing to proposals.

**Month 6**

* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Labor efficiency ratio of 3.0 across your portfolio.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* Writing and presenting proposals independently.

**Month 9**

* 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
* 20% of your retainers expanded over a rolling 90 days.
* Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.
* Representing McGaw independently in sales and partner meetings.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not a hands-on build seat although you will get into the tools if you need to.
* Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write and present proposals, own retention and expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
* Not a people management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Managing a team comes later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* National holidays off.
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1.** Learn our clients, delivery model, and commercial standards. Meet every stakeholder on your accounts. Shadow client meetings, QBRs, and pre-sales calls.

**Months 2 and 3.** Take ownership of your accounts. Run the meetings, rebuild the roadmaps, take over the budget conversations. An experienced account owner stays close.

**Months 4 to 6.** Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

**After 6 months.** You own the commercial arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. You help define what the next hires look like.

**What is hard.** You are accountable for delivery you did not perform, done mostly by people in another time zone. Managing that gap is most of the job. Pre-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. Expansion targets are real and measured.

title: Director Técnico de Integración, hibrido
description:
Director Técnico de Integración
  
**Descripción de Puesto:** Director Técnico de Integración (España)
  
**Ubicación:** España (Modelo Híbrido / Remoto)
  
**Sector:** Consultoría Tecnológica / Middleware Integration Services
  
**Reporta a:** CTO / CEO
  
1. Resumen del Puesto
  
Buscamos un Director Técnico de Integración para liderar y consolidar la práctica técnica en España. El candidato asumirá un rol estratégico, posicionándose como el nexo clave entre el negocio, las cuentas estratégicas y la entrega técnica.
  
**Su labor abarcará el ciclo de vida completo de las soluciones:** desde la fase de preventa y consultoría ejecutiva con perfiles C-Level, pasando por la definición de arquitectura de integración y la supervisión del delivery de múltiples proyectos simultáneos, hasta el liderazgo directo de los equipos técnicos.
  
2. Responsabilidades Principales
  
Estrategia y Dirección Técnica
  
Definir la visión y los estándares tecnológicos de la práctica de integración en España.
  
**Diseñar e impulsar arquitecturas avanzadas:** orientadas a servicios (SOA), APIs, microservicios, Event-Driven Architectures y mensajería en entornos híbridos y multi-cloud.
  
Establecer e implementar modelos de gobierno de APIs, marcos de calidad (ej. CMMI), buenas prácticas y metodologías de diseño.
  
Preventa y Desarrollo de Negocio (Pre-Sales Consulting)
  
Colaborar directamente con el área comercial en la detección de oportunidades, elaboración de propuestas técnicas y económicas (RFP/RFI) y su defensa ante grandes clientes.
  
Liderar sesiones de consultoría de descubrimiento e interlocución con CIOs, CTOs y directores de IT para transformar necesidades de negocio en arquitecturas viables.
  
Diseñar Pruebas de Concepto (PoC) y arquitecturas de alto nivel (High-Level Design) para demostrar el valor técnico de las soluciones.
  
Gestión de Proyectos, Clientes y Delivery
  
Supervisar la ejecución y entrega de múltiples proyectos de integración en paralelo, asegurando cumplimiento de tiempos, calidad y rentabilidad.
  
Mantener la relación ejecutiva con stakeholders clave y grandes cuentas, actuando como referente y punto de escalado.
  
Gestionar riesgos, desbloquear desviaciones críticas y coordinar la resolución de incidencias en entornos productivos.
  
  
Liderazgo y Desarrollo de Equipos
  
Dirigir, inspirar y mentorizar a un equipo multidisciplinar formado por Arquitectos de Integración, Devops y Developers.
  
Fomentar planes de desarrollo profesional, la capacitación técnica continua y la asignación eficiente de recursos a las distintas iniciativas.
  
3. Requisitos del Perfil
  
Experiencia Requerida
  
Más de 15 años de trayectoria en el sector IT, con al menos 8 años en posiciones de dirección técnica, Delivery Manager, Technical Product Owner o Integration Lead en grandes consultoras o clientes corporativos.
  
Sólida experiencia demostrada en preventa tecnológica, licitaciones de gran envergadura y consultoría de valor.
  
Dominio en el diseño e implementación de middlewares de integración, orquestación de servicios y ecosistemas de APIs/microservicios.
  
Conocimientos Técnicos
  
**Middleware Integración:** Dominio de plataformas y herramientas como WSO2, MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus o equivalentes.
  
**Arquitectura Patrones:** Experiencia sólida en REST/SOAP, Microservicios, Event-Driven Architecture, API Management, ETL/ELT e integración con sistemas legados.
  
**Bases de Datos Cloud:** Manejo de BBDD relacionales y NoSQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Couchbase) y plataformas cloud (Microsoft Azure, AWS o GCP).
  
**Metodologías Herramientas:** Marcos ágiles (Scrum, Kanban), gestión de roadmaps/backlogs y uso experto de Jira, Confluence y Azure DevOps.
  
Competencias Clave e Idiomas
  
Visión de negocio y alta capacidad de negociación técnica y funcional.
  
Capacidad de liderazgo, gestión de talento y trabajo bajo entornos de alta demanda.
  
**Idiomas:** Español nativo o muy fluido e Inglés C1 (imprescindible para entornos internacionales y documentación).
  
  
WSO2, Gravitee, MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus,SOA , API Management, Microservicios, Event Driven, REST, SOAP, ETL / ELT,

title: Lead Product Manager - RPG
description:
**Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love.** We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.  
  
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.  
  
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.  
  
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.  
  
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**

As a **Lead Product Manager** on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.

Your main responsibilities will include:

* **Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles:** core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
* **Own LiveOps end-to-end.** You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
* **Lead your team.** You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
* **Oversee the monetization model.** Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
* **Drive growth, in partnership with UA.** You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
* **Cross-functional excellence.** You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
* **Set the bar.** Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
* **Stay hands-on when it counts.** This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for someone with **several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,** with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

**Product & RPG expertise**

* P**roduct experience on live F2P mobile games**, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
* Strong fluency in **RPG mechanics and meta systems:** progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
* Ideally, you’ve taken a title **from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps**, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

**LiveOps & Execution**

* Deep **LiveOps experience**, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
* Strong track record **owning features end-to-end**: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of **what a live team can realistically ship and maintain**, balancing ambition with feasibility.

**Leadership & Ways of working**

* Strong **cross-functional leadership**, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
* A **strategist and builder**: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands-on with the game, systems and data.
* Thrives in **lean, fast-moving, high-autonomy teams** with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

**Our Culture**

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

* **Ambition**: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough.”
* **Humility**: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
* **Curiosity**: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
* **Focus**: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we dive deep into the details.

  
**Benefits**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
* **Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
* **Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
* **Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
* ✈️ **Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
* **Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

title: Product Manager
description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

**Job Description**

**Position:** Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network

**Location:** EMEA, remote

The **Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network** is accountable for defining and leading the global strategy for strategic site engagement and partnerships within Global Clinical Operations. The role establishes the strategic architecture, operating principles, governance, portfolio priorities, and performance framework that connect Therapeutic Business Unit (TBU) strategy and Global Clinical Operations priorities with regional and country activation and local site engagement.

The Executive Director shapes how the business identifies, prioritizes, develops, and activates relationships with investigators, health systems, strategic sites, and research networks to improve access to patients, accelerate clinical development, strengthen study delivery, and create differentiated value for customers and TBUs. The role leads the global Site Strategy & Collaborations organization, provides strategic direction through regional Site Network leadership and matrix partners, serves as an executive sponsor for priority partnerships, and advises senior leadership on network strategy, partnership investment, external ecosystem trends, and future capability needs.

**Essential Functions and Other Job Information:**

  

* Define and own the global Site Strategy & Collaborations vision, multi-year strategic roadmap, and priorities aligned with Global Clinical Operations objectives and TBU portfolio strategy.
* Translate TBU therapeutic and portfolio priorities into a differentiated global site-network strategy, defining where, with whom, and how Thermo Fisher should build strategic site relationships to support current and future clinical development needs.
* Establish the global strategic framework for site partnerships, including partnership segmentation, value propositions, engagement principles, governance, decision rights, escalation pathways, and standards for relationship development and activation.
* Lead the global operating model that connects enterprise and TBU strategy with regional Site Network Leads, Feasibility & Site Selection (FSS), Country Operations, and local site teams, enabling one connected strategy with clear ownership and accountability.
* Create a closed-loop mechanism through which regional and local site intelligence informs global and TBU strategy, while global portfolio priorities are translated into practical country and site engagement plans.
* Own global prioritization of strategic sites, health systems, investigators, and research networks using portfolio needs, patient access, performance data, market intelligence, customer strategy, and emerging capability requirements.
* Partner with TBU leaders, Clinical Operations, Medical, Commercial, Business Development, FSS, and Country Operations to embed site strategy early in portfolio planning, customer strategy, proposals, bid defenses, and strategic account discussions.
* Define and govern a global performance framework and differentiated KPIs that demonstrate the operational, strategic, customer, and business value of site partnerships, including proof points that inform investment and prioritization decisions.
* Use data, analytics, external market intelligence, and network insights to identify strategic opportunities, anticipate risks, inform network design, and recommend changes to partnership strategy and operating model.
* Champion innovative partnership models, digital capabilities, data-sharing approaches, and collaboration mechanisms that strengthen site engagement and differentiate Thermo Fisher in the clinical research ecosystem.
* Lead organizational transformation and change initiatives that position Site Strategy & Collaborations as a strategic enterprise capability rather than a transactional or support function.
* Advise senior and executive leadership on site ecosystem trends, strategic partnership opportunities, competitive dynamics, investment choices, and organizational capabilities required to support future growth.
* Represent Thermo Fisher externally at executive customer engagements, strategic partnership discussions, investigator forums, industry events, and other high-level engagements that advance the company's position as a preferred clinical research partner.

**Job Knowledge**

Applies expert knowledge of global clinical operations, strategic site engagement, feasibility, portfolio strategy, investigator and institutional partnerships, clinical trial delivery, and external ecosystem dynamics to shape global strategy and investment priorities. Recognized as an enterprise thought leader who integrates TBU strategy, customer needs, market intelligence, and site-network capabilities to influence organizational design, partnership models, and future business direction.

**Job Complexity**

Leads a global capability at the intersection of TBUs, Global Clinical Operations, regions, countries, and the external site ecosystem. Resolves ambiguity and competing priorities across therapeutic areas, geographies, customers, and functions while making strategic choices that influence network design, partnership investment, organizational capability, and measurable business outcomes.

Leads highly complex initiatives requiring strategic thinking, executive influence, and cross-functional leadership

**Interactions / Business Relationships**

Builds and maintains executive relationships with TBU Leaders, Global Clinical Operations leadership, Regional Site Network Leads, FSS leadership, Country Operations, Commercial, Medical, Business Development, Finance, and other cross-functional partners. Externally, engages senior investigators and leaders of strategic research institutions, health systems, and site networks, representing Thermo Fisher as an executive strategic partner.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic/vocational qualification. Advanced degree (MBA, MS, MPH, PharmD, or equivalent) preferred.
* Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (typically comparable to 15+ years), including significant leadership experience in global clinical operations, site strategy, feasibility, strategic partnerships, project delivery or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience leading director-level and global cross-functional organizations, translating portfolio strategy into operating priorities, establishing strategic external partnerships, and influencing enterprise-level decisions is strongly preferred.

* Therapeutic expertise and portfolio strategy translation into site-network priorities
* Strategic site partnership architecture, segmentation, and governance
* Deep understanding of global clinical operations, feasibility, and the investigator/site ecosystem

Establishes the strategic partnership framework, operating model, governance, decision rights, performance standards, and investment principles that guide global, regional, country, and site-level engagement.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

**Vision & Strategy**

* Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
* Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
* Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

**Technical Product Leadership**

* Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
* Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
* Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
* Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

**Rapid Prototyping with AI**

* Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.
* Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

**Execution & Team Leadership**

* Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.
* Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.
* Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

**Mobile & Distribution**

* Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.
* Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.
* Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

**Mandatory:**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.
* Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).
* Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.
* Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.
* Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.
* Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.
* Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.
* A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.
* You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have:**

* Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.
* Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.
* Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.
* A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.
* Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).
* A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.
* An engineering background or computer science degree.
* Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

**Why this role:**

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**About Darkroom**

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a **Social Media Manager** to own day-to-day social strategy and execution across a portfolio of client accounts. You live inside culture and platforms — you know what's working, why it's working, and how to translate that into a content calendar that builds real communities, not just posting schedules. You're equally comfortable briefing in a creative team, jumping into the comments to manage community, and sitting across from a client explaining why a strategy shift makes sense.

You'll work closely with Associate Directors and Directors of Creative Strategy to build out the social calendar, brief creative execution that feels inventive rather than templated, and manage the client relationship day to day — all while keeping the account organized and operating smoothly.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day-to-day creative execution for organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
* Partner with the Director of Creative Strategy to build out the social media calendar and plan
* Brief and direct Designers and Editors on inventive, culturally-relevant statics, motion, video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
* Lead community management in a way that actively builds community, not just responds to it
* Write copy for social posts, flexing tone and voice by platform and client
* Work alongside the creator team on UGC briefs and execution
* Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction

* A deep, current understanding of culture and how it moves social — not just what's trending, but why

* Strong grasp of the briefing process — you know how to brief creative that's actually inventive

* Already using AI tools thoughtfully in your workflow — you know where they help and where they don't

* No experience running community management

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

**Talan – Positive Innovation**

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

**Talan at a Glance**

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

**Our Core Areas of Expertise**

* **Data & Technologies:** We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.
* **Cloud & Application Services:** We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.
* **Management & Innovation Consulting:** We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

**We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.**

 **Job Description**

We are looking to join a Senior consultant within the **Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC)**, a globally distributed team of cybersecurity professionals responsible for protecting complex and diverse technology environments.

The role is primarily focused on enhancing threat detection and cybersecurity operations capabilities through activities such as security content management, quality assurance and validation of detection mechanisms, detection use case lifecycle management, onboarding and integration of new security data sources, reporting, and process optimization.

This is an excellent opportunity for professionals interested in working within a large-scale international cybersecurity environment, where they will play a key role in the continuous improvement of security monitoring and threat detection services across multiple customer landscapes. The position combines elements of **Security Operations, Threat Detection Engineering, SIEM optimization, cyber risk management, and operational excellence**, offering exposure to a wide variety of cybersecurity technologies and challenges.

**Main Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the development, implementation, validation, tuning, and maintenance of security monitoring, analytics, and detection capabilities across SIEM, EDR, cloud, and other cybersecurity platforms.
* Support the operation, maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of security monitoring and threat detection services.
* Participate in the onboarding, integration, testing, and validation of security data sources, telemetry feeds, and monitoring capabilities.
* Contribute to security content management activities, including use case lifecycle management, rule reviews, testing, tuning, and content quality assurance.
* Collaborate with cyber threat intelligence, incident response, and cybersecurity operations teams to translate operational and threat intelligence requirements into effective detection and monitoring capabilities.
* Under guidance, participate in cybersecurity architecture reviews of new or existing solutions and provide recommendations to enhance security monitoring and detection effectiveness.
* Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of cybersecurity operations metrics, dashboards, KPIs, and service performance reports.
* Review, validate, and assess the effectiveness of detections, monitoring configurations, operational processes, and service deliverables, identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Gather and analyze operational feedback to identify opportunities for tuning, optimization, reduction of false positives, and improvement of overall detection quality.
* Contribute to quality assurance activities, including process reviews, control validation, service quality assessments, and implementation of corrective actions.
* Support the development, review, and maintenance of CSOC procedures, standards, documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Prepare and present technical reports, summaries, findings, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

  
**Qualifications**

**On-Call Availability (On-Call Shift System)**

* **Mandatory 24/7 On-Call Rotation:** You will be required to participate in a rotating on-call shift schedule from Monday to Sunday.
* **What this means:** This **does not mean you will be actively working 24/7** or during late-night shifts. Instead, you will be **on standby** outside of standard working hours, meaning you must be reachable and available to log in and resolve critical system incidents only if they arise.
* **Frequency:** The approximate rotation frequency is **one full week (7 consecutive days) every X months**, depending on the number of team members

Must have:

* **+5 years of relevant experience in information technology field, including triage of alerts and supporting security incidents**
* Proven experience on administering a **SIEM platform**, preferably either **Splunk or Microsoft** **Sentinel SIEM**
* Proven experience with the usual toolbox available in a SOC (e.g., SIEMs, EDRs) and being able to autonomously perform technical analysis of security threats and collaborate with Incident Response team
* Deep knowledge of **Microsoft Security Tools** (e.g. M365, Cloud App Security, Azure,Defender for Endpoints, Azure Security, Azure Sentinel and XDR)
* Deep Knowledge of Cloud technologies (e.g. **Azure, AWS and GCP**)
* Deep knowledge of SIEM tools like **Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, MS Sentinel, ELK Stac**
* Knowledge of at least one **EDR solution** (MS Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike)
* Knowledge of email security, network monitoring, and incident response
* Knowledge of **Linux/Mac/Windows**
* **C1 English proficiency**

Nice to have:

* Experience in building SIEM architectures from initial design to implementation, including designing data ingestion pipelines for diverse log sources across cloud and on-prem environments
* Proven knowledge of monitoring AWS environment (Iaas, Saas, Paas)
* Knowledge of at least one general-purpose or shell scripting language (e.g. Ruby, Bash, PowerShell, Python, etc.)

**Desirable certifications:**

* MCSE, CCNA, Microsoft Azure (e.g., SC-200), GCIH, CEH, GCFA or any GIAC/similar certification

**Required Soft Skills:**

* Excellent communication skills
* Customer-facing experience and oral communication skills
* Ability to write documentation & reports
* Creativity/ ability to find innovative solutions
* Willingness to learn on the job
* Conflict management & cooperation

 **Additional Information**

**What do we offer you?**

* **Remote Position**
* Freelance, full-time contract.
* Training and career development.
* Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

**If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you!**

**Talan Spain’s commitment to non-discrimination based on gender, race, ideology, or any other reason, in accordance with the company’s "Equality Plan" and the current regulations on gender equality between women and men (Royal Decree-Law 6/2019).**

description:
**About airSlate**

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - **Sign****Now, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms** - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.

We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the **United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines**.

At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

**About Marketing team:**

The marketing team handles comprehensive 360º communication and comprises over 150 people. We manage all aspects in-house and operate a robust automation engine. Our combined monthly traffic across all brands exceeds 31 million. As a marketing team member, you'll play a crucial role in the upcoming phase of our brand's growth as we expand and introduce new products to the market.

And now, we are looking for a **Senior Email Operations Team Manager** who is prepared to contribute to the next chapter of our company's growth.

### **What you'll be working on:**

*Strategic*

* Own email-channel-driven attributed revenue as a business outcome, setting the strategic direction for how email contributes to LTV, retention, and expansion across airSlate products
* Define email and push notification strategy in line with product and marketing strategies
* Lead churn-prevention and win-back initiatives across email and push notifications as coordinated, signal-driven programs rather than one-off campaigns
* Set the email roadmap for 2026 and beyond — audit existing programs, identify gaps and quick wins, and prioritize initiatives across three products against attributed revenue targets
* Define how email fits within multi-channel orchestration, establishing boundaries and handoffs between email, in-product messaging, and other channels

*Data & use of data*

* Translate behavioral signals, predictive churn scores, and lifecycle stage classifications into actionable segmentation logic and program triggers
* Define data requirements for email programs — specify the user signals, cohort definitions, and event triggers needed from the data engineering team, and own those requests
* Own the team's contribution to the revenue attribution model — partner with data teams to define lifecycle-stage KPIs and validate that email is correctly credited under the new attribution framework
* Own email dashboards with the data team and align them with lifecycle dashboards, so attribution reporting accurately reflects email's contribution to revenue at each funnel stage
* Use generative and agentic AI tooling to drive personalization and automation at scale across a large, multi-product subscriber base

*Operational*

* Manage and develop three email marketing specialists — set priorities, coach on execution quality, and connect daily work to strategic lifecycle goals
* Coordinate across the email development team, data team, demand gen, and product stakeholders to deliver lifecycle programs end-to-end within airEML
* Maintain and evolve automated email journeys across all four products, with the authority to rebuild or retire programs where data supports it
* Ensure email deliverability and list health at scale across a large, multi-product subscriber base

### **What we expect from you:**

* 5+ years in email marketing as a senior contributor or leader, retention marketing, or lifecycle marketing with an email focus — B2C or B2B SaaS/subscription products at scale preferred
* Proven ownership of an email and/or retention/lifecycle program end-to-end — strategy, journey design, segmentation logic, and KPI ownership, not only execution
* Familiarity with attribution models, including how attribution windows affect reported email performance and how to navigate model transitions
* Experience using behavioral data and predictive models for segmentation, such as churn scoring or lifecycle stage classification
* Hands-on experience with a major marketing automation or email platform (Braze, Klaviyo, Iterable, Marketo, HubSpot, or an internal equivalent)
* A track record of cross-functional collaboration with Product and Data Science teams, not siloed within Marketing
* Strategic thinking at the program level, not only the campaign level
* Strong analytical skills, including comfort with dashboards and data-warehouse-sourced data, and the ability to derive lifecycle insights independently
* Understanding of email deliverability and list health at scale (100K+ subscriber base)
* A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher English, written and spoken

### **What helps you rock:**

* Experience in a multi-product or multi-brand environment

**What we offer**

**Flexible working environment** - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.

**Competitive compensation and stock options** - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.

**Professional growth and learning** - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.

**Health and well‑being** - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.

**Family‑friendly culture** - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.

**Giving back** - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.

**Open communication** - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.
