description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

Join our Visual Merchandising team in this **temporary opportunity** and support the creation of inspiring retail experiences across our stores and windows. Reporting to the VM Manager, you will play a key role in bringing LOEWE’s visual identity to life, supporting seasonal launches, events, and VM guideline development.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Support the VM Manager in the development and execution of Leather Goods (LG) visual merchandising, including accessory styling and window styling guideline shoots.
* Coordinate samples, props, and product organization throughout the VM guideline creation process for the LG category.
* Assist in the development and production of visual merchandising guidelines for LG across stores.
* Support the implementation of LG seasonal window displays, in-store launches, pop-ins, pop-ups, and special events.
* Ensure visual merchandising materials and assets related to LG are organized and updated.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to help deliver LG projects on time and according to LOEWE’s brand standards.
* Monitor details across all VM projects to ensure consistency and excellence in execution.
* Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the Visual Merchandising team.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* 1+ year of experience in Visual Merchandising, Retail, or Fashion.
* Strong interest in Leather Goods, fashion, arts, crafts, and design, with a good aesthetic sensibility.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational and time management skills.
* Proactive, flexible, and solutions-oriented, with a collaborative mindset.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator).
* Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Hematologist - Medical Director
description:
Job Summary :

We are seeking a Hematologist - Medical Director to join our dynamic team. The Medical Director will have overall responsibility for providing medical, scientific, and strategic leadership for the successful planning, execution, and reporting of clinical trials. Additionally, this role acts as the Medpace internal medical expert and will serve as a medical resource for the review, presentation, and interpretation of results in the Clinical Study Report. The Medical Director will also be involved in the development of new clinical projects, including study design, protocol, and project plans as required. We are currently seeking Medical Directors in different locations.

\*\*All Medical Directors have hybrid WFH flexibility.

Responsibilities :

* Provide medical management and expertise for clinical trials;
* Contribute medical expertise to study reports, regulatory documents, and manuscripts;
* Manage safety issues in clinical trials and work closely with associates in evaluation and assessment of the trials;
* Participate in new business development through involvement in proposal and sponsor meetings as requested;
* Coordinate with other departments in all phases of the studies and trials including feasibility assessments, design processes, educational efforts, management of medical information, and reviewing and editing of medical documents;
* Follow specific research related protocol and lead others in strict adherence to the policies.

Qualifications :

* Must have an M.D. degree or equivalent. Board certification and current medical licensure are preferred;
* Prior clinical trial research experience preferred; and
* Previous experience in pharmaceutical-related clinical research is preferred.

Travel: up to 20%

Medpace Overview :

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace? :

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

***Purpose-Driven Work***

* + Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

***Collaborative Culture***

* + Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
  + Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

***Continuous Growth & Development***

* + Office based environment with on-site mentors
  + Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
  + Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
  + Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
  + An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

***Other Employee Benefits***

* + Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
  + Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
  + Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
  + Company-sponsored social events

*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*

**What to Expect Next**

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Partner Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Ultralytics:**

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

**Join the team powering the future of vision AI**  
**Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour!** Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.  
  
**Who we are**  
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to **simplify AI for everyone**. As the creators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.  
  
Following our **$30M Series A round**, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.  
  
We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.  
  
**About the role**  
As a **Partner Solutions Engineer**, you'll work side by side with our Head of Partnerships to help partners build, integrate, and deploy computer vision solutions with Ultralytics YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, scope partner projects, and turn requirements into practical solution architectures, demos, and deployments.  
  
This is a hands-on, client-facing role with no people-management responsibilities. You'll collaborate with partners and internal engineering teams across model training, export, quantization, and cross-platform deployment. You'll thrive here if you combine deep technical curiosity with clear communication, sound judgment, and a bias for getting working solutions into users' hands.  
  
**What you'll do**  
**Partner solutions & delivery**

* Lead partner-facing technical calls, discovery, and project scoping.
* Design solution architectures for YOLO training, integration, export, and deployment.
* Build technical demos and rapid prototypes using Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.
* Support model export and INT8 quantization across ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, and LiteRT.
* Help partners deploy across Linux, macOS, and Windows, and document clear implementation guidance.

**Technical collaboration**

* Work side by side with the Head of Partnerships to advance partner integrations and unblock technical work.
* Review partner and community GitHub pull requests and share actionable feedback.
* Use OpenAI and Anthropic APIs to prototype client tools and accelerate partner workflows.
* Share partner needs and technical findings with Product and Engineering teams.

**Partner enablement**

* Create technical documentation, demos, and integration guidance using the Ultralytics docs and guides.
* Represent Ultralytics in partner meetings, technical events, and occasional travel.

**Skills and experience**  
**Core requirements**

* Experience in computer vision and AI, with practical knowledge of Python, YOLO, OpenCV, and PyTorch.
* Experience training, exporting, and deploying models; familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, LiteRT, and INT8 quantization.
* Proven ability to lead partner-facing technical calls, scope work, and deliver demos or solution architectures.
* Experience reviewing GitHub pull requests and writing clear technical documentation.
* Comfortable working across Linux, macOS, and Windows, with Docker and common development workflows.
* Strong spoken and written English; able to travel for partner meetings and events.
* Resourceful, collaborative, and comfortable taking ownership in a high-performance startup.

**Nice to have**

* Deep knowledge of vendor SDKs such as CUDA, ROCm, Vela, or Vitis AI.
* Experience with edge CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, including Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Snapdragon, or Arm platforms.
* Linux, Docker, and CI experience on ARM64 and x86; mobile or web deployment on Android, iOS, or WebGPU.
* C++ skills, performance profiling, or experience with PyTorch and OpenCV optimization.
* Familiarity with cloud ML platforms such as SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Azure ML, and video pipelines like DeepStream or Triton.
* Experience creating talks, blogs, or demo videos; additional Spanish, Italian, or Mandarin language skills.

**Cultural fit**  
At Ultralytics, we set **bold goals** and execute with **speed, precision, and teamwork**. We're driven by **hard work, ambition, and resilience** — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.  
  
**You'll thrive here if you:**

* Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.
* Combine technical depth with a client-first, hands-on approach.
* Value **excellence, grit, and creativity** in equal measure.
* See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.

**Our culture is built around our core values:**

* **Relentless progress:** Constant evolution and improvement.
* **Strive for excellence:** Perseverance and attention to detail.
* **Actions, not words:** Focus on delivering meaningful results.
* **Act with urgency:** Seize fleeting opportunities.
* **Open access to all:** Transparent communication and collaboration.

Learn more in our Ultralytics Handbook.  
  
**Compensation and benefits**  
We reward **excellence and impact** — not just tenure or title.

* **Competitive salary:** Reflecting your experience and contribution.
* **Equity packages:** We want our success to be yours too.
* **On-site collaboration:** Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs.
* **Flexible working hours:** We value results over routines.
* **Generous time off:** 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.
* **Tech & tools:** Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.
* **Gear:** Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.
* **Learning & development:** Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.
* **High impact:** Your work will shape the future of vision AI.

Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture, values, and teams.  
  
**Where and how you can work**  
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.

* This role is **on-site** at one of our global hubs: London or Madrid.
* Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country of application.

We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen.  
  
**Why join us**  
We're not just building models — we're building the **ecosystem powering the future of vision AI**. If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment.  
  
**Ready to build the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI?** **Apply now.**

**What we offer:**

**Cutting-Edge, Next-Generation AI Computer Vision Technology:** Contribute to building cutting-edge computer vision AI models based on the YOLO framework.

**Impactful Work:** Shape the future of AI-powered solutions that transform industries.

**Collaborative Culture:** Join a talented and passionate team that values open communication and innovation.

**Ultralytics Handbook**

Comprehensive guide to our company's mission, vision, values, and operational practices. This handbook is designed to provide key insights and resources for our (future) team members, collaborators, and community to align with Ultralytics' core principles.

Link: https://handbook.ultralytics.com/

*Ultralytics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.*

title: Manager, CRM Category Expansion
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**

**Manager, CRM Category Expansion**

The **Manager, CRM Category Expansion** owns every scheduled brand campaign across email, SMS, push, and in-app for the UK, Germany, and France. This includes new arrivals, restocks, seasonal and gifting moments, and key discount events like Black Friday/Cyber Monday and Quince Day. These are broad, brand-wide sends that go out to the whole customer base or large segments, designed to take customers beyond the one category they already know us for and introduce them to the rest of the range.

Reporting into the UK/EU CRM Director, this person runs the process end-to-end: briefing, selecting products with Merchandising, briefing Design, aligning with US Marketing, localizing copy, and partnering with Tech on features like dynamic product/price modules — then building, QA'ing, and shipping every send, reading results, and continuously improving toward faster, more personalized delivery.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the UK/EU campaign calendar end-to-end — brief, build, localize, QA, and send across email, SMS, push, and in-app
* Brief and coordinate every campaign with Merchandising, Design, Copy, and US Marketing
* Own audience segmentation, frequency caps, and suppression/consent logic for smarter targeting
* Build and maintain the production engine: modular templates, dynamic product feeds, and reusable content blocks
* Partner with Tech and Data to improve the comms themselves (dynamic pricing, live stock) and run a rigorous testing programme (send-time, segments, incrementality holdouts)
* Own deliverability and list health across all three markets
* Turn results into monthly insights and a steady pipeline of new campaign ideas, informed by industry trends and testing new formats
* Report weekly on performance (revenue, CTR, unsub/complaint rates, incrementality) and coordinate with the Lifecycle team

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years CRM/email marketing in DTC/ecommerce, including 3+ years running a full campaign calendar end-to-end (not just triggered flows)
* Hands-on with Iterable (or Braze/Klaviyo/SFMC), including multi-market campaign builds with dynamic content and personalization
* Experience delivering SMS, push, and in-app campaigns, plus enough HTML/CSS to brief and QA email builds
* Segmentation and deliverability fluency (engagement tiers, suppression, frequency caps), including reading Postmaster Tools
* SQL working knowledge — able to self-serve audience/results checks in Looker without an analyst
* A/B testing and incrementality rigor; comfortable setting up and reading holdouts with the Data team
* Already using AI in daily workflows, and ruthless about QA and automating it
* Strong multi-stakeholder operator (Merchandising, Design, Copy, US Marketing, Tech) with working knowledge of UK/EU marketing regulations (GDPR, PECR, German/French requirements)

**Pay Range: GBP 66,000 - 76,000**

**WHY QUINCE?**

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

Content Specialist
description:
It's more than a job
  
  
At Kuehne+Nagel, a career in Marketing and Communications means creating inspiring campaigns and consistent brand strategies, but it's also something more. Thanks to your creative work, your colleagues have a strong base to continue conversations with customers across the globe, some working on the seamless delivery of sensitive semiconductors to mobile phone manufacturers, or building one-of-a-kind logistics solutions for wind turbines. At Kuehne+Nagel, we all play a more important role than we might imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
We’re looking for a Content Specialist to join our Center of Excellence (CoE), an internal creative powerhouse that supports marketing initiatives worldwide.
  
You are the content expert of our team and your designated topics. Your main projects will be to develop content on key growth topics, outlined in marketing plans of the broader team. Alongside our marketing specialists—the strategists behind our work—you’ll be developing various B2B content pieces for paid media, the website, emails, and other marketing assets throughout campaign journeys. You’ll connect, interview, and exchange ideas with the logistics experts responsible for your topics to better understand the technicalities and key business messages. Equipped with this support, your work is to bring fresh ideas on how to craft on-brand content that resonates with our current and potential customer base.
  
  
How you create impact
  
  

* Collaborate with marketing specialists to support campaigns and structure content requests
* Craft clear, persuasive, and original copy throughout all iterations of your projects and ensure accuracy through proofreading—grammar, cohesiveness, and brand consistency
* Collaborate with marketing specialists on creating content briefs and producing assets for external agencies, ensuring message and brand alignment is adhered to
* Revise and enhance adverts, campaigns, and other content based on feedback from stakeholders in the business, sales, or marketing team
* Manage the content process from production to completion, ensuring quality and timeliness
* Present new ideas and play an active role in the conceptualisation of content strategies in collaboration with stakeholders, marketers, and the CoE team
* Participate in regular industry update meetings with stakeholders in the business and marketing teams to stay informed and an engaged member of the team

What we would like you to bring
  
  

* Bachelor/Masters education in creative advertising, journalism, communication, or similar fields
* At least 2 years of experience in a similar role, B2B a plus
* Native-level proficiency in English with a demonstrated ability to write clear, effective copy in various styles
* A strong communicator, with the confidence to clarify content requests and transform ideas into tangible first drafts
* Strong B2B commercial awareness and ability to unpack complex topics to engage target audiences
* Excellent organisational skills and an affinity to integrate analytical feedback

What's in it for you
  
  
At Kuehne+Nagel, you will have the opportunity to grow your expertise, shape processes, and deliver innovative solutions for some of the world’s largest customers. We are continuously expanding our global network and product portfolio, creating career opportunities across diverse functions and regions. As a leader in the logistics industry, we offer a collaborative, digital, and customer-focused environment where you will work with motivated colleagues from around the world. We look forward to receiving your comprehensive online application.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.
  
We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

title: Senior Analyst (AM) – Social & Activation Strategist
description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

**About the Role**

The Senior Analyst (AM) – Social & Activation Strategist supports the day-to-day delivery of integrated digital and social programmes, primarily for Wella and Galderma. The role combines client coordination, content development and publishing, community management, creator partnerships, social listening and performance reporting.
  
Working closely with the wider Digital team, the successful candidate will help identify cultural, platform and real-time opportunities that strengthen campaign relevance, responsiveness and effectiveness. This role is suited to someone who is organised, digitally curious and comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast-paced agency environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support day-to-day client coordination and delivery across Wella, Galderma and other Digital assignments.
* Help plan, develop, review and publish social content in line with brand, channel and campaign requirements.
* Manage community engagement and support timely, culturally relevant responses to audience conversations.
* Coordinate creator and influencer activity, including research, outreach, briefing, content tracking and reporting.
* Monitor social platforms, cultural trends and emerging conversations to identify real-time opportunities and potential risks.
* Support social listening, campaign measurement and performance reporting, translating results into clear insights and recommended actions.
* Maintain content calendars, status documents and project timelines, escalating delivery risks when required.
* Collaborate with strategy, creative, account and production colleagues to deliver high-quality, integrated work.
* Apply strong quality control across copy, assets, publishing and reporting outputs.

Contribute to other assignments and new-business opportunities as team priorities require.
  
  
**Experience, Skills and Attributes**

* A minimum of 4–5 years of relevant experience within digital/social media, influencer or creator teams, preferably in an agency environment.
* Native-level or fully professional Spanish, with strong awareness of local culture, tone and audience behaviour.
* Professional working proficiency in English.
* Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with major social platforms, publishing workflows, social listening, creator marketing and performance metrics.
* Collaborative, curious and proactive, with sound judgement, clear communication and a genuine interest in beauty, health, culture and digital trends.

  
This is a fixed-term role created to maintain continuity and high-quality delivery across key client accounts during a nine-month period of leave coverage.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

### **Description**

**Why Join DAZN Bet?**At DAZN Bet, we're creating a betting experience built around the sports fan, combining DAZN's world-class sports content, audience and technology with an exciting Sportsbook and Gaming proposition.

As we continue to grow in Spain, our affiliate channel plays an important role in reaching new customers and building sustainable market share.

We're looking for an experienced **Affiliate Account Manager – Spain** to take ownership of our affiliate partnerships in the Spanish market. You'll identify new opportunities, build strong commercial relationships and use performance data to drive high-quality customer acquisition.

This is a great opportunity to take ownership of a key growth channel within an ambitious international betting business while working closely with both our Spanish market team and central DAZN Bet functions.  
  
**The Role**

As **Affiliate Account Manager – Spain**, you'll support the continued growth and optimisation of DAZN Bet's affiliate acquisition channel across the Spanish market.

You'll be responsible for identifying, recruiting and activating new affiliate partners while managing and developing our existing relationships to improve acquisition, revenue and long-term customer value.

Working closely with the **Managing Director Spain, central Affiliate team, local Marketing and CRM teams, Compliance and BI/Analytics**, you'll provide dedicated local ownership of the Spanish affiliate programme.

You'll ensure our affiliate activity is commercially effective, appropriately localised and fully aligned with Spanish gambling regulation, Responsible Gambling requirements and DAZN Bet's brand standards.

### **What You’ll Be Doing:**

  

* Identify, recruit and onboard high-quality affiliate partners across Spain, focusing on sustainable customer acquisition and long-term player value.
* Build and manage strong relationships with affiliate partners, owning campaigns, placements, performance discussions and day-to-day commercial requirements.
* Negotiate and manage CPA, Revenue Share and Hybrid agreements, ensuring commercial terms deliver sustainable acquisition economics and strong ROI.
* Monitor and optimise performance across FTDs, CPA, conversion, GGR/NGR, retention and ROI, using data to identify opportunities and improve partner performance.
* Coordinate with local Marketing, CRM and Creative teams to deliver effective affiliate campaigns, landing pages, content, promotions and supporting assets.
* Ensure affiliate activity complies with Spanish gambling regulation, advertising requirements, Responsible Gambling standards and DAZN Bet brand guidelines.
* Own reporting and forecasting across affiliate performance, spend and partner activity, providing clear insights and recommendations to local and central stakeholders.
* Work closely with Marketing, CRM, Commercial, Compliance, Finance, Product, BI and the central Affiliate team to resolve issues and maximise channel performance.
* Stay close to the Spanish betting and affiliate landscape, identifying new partners, competitor activity, market trends and opportunities to grow the channel.

### **What You’ll Bring:**

  

* 5+ years' experience in affiliate marketing, digital partnerships, account management, business development or performance marketing, ideally within iGaming, online sports betting or casino.
* Strong knowledge of affiliate commercial models including CPA, Revenue Share and Hybrid agreements, with proven experience negotiating and managing commercial partnerships.
* A track record of managing and optimising acquisition performance across FTDs, CPA, conversion, GGR/NGR, retention and ROI.
* Strong analytical and commercial judgement, with the ability to interpret performance data and turn insights into clear actions and recommendations.
* Experience managing external partners and building long-term, commercially successful relationships.
* Good understanding of digital acquisition, tracking, attribution, affiliate platforms and the wider performance marketing ecosystem.
* Strong knowledge of the Spanish regulated betting and gaming market, including gambling advertising and promotional requirements.
* Excellent organisation, negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to operate independently in a fast-moving international business.
* Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with BI and affiliate management platforms would be advantageous.

### **About DAZN**

At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. We're using world-class technology to transform sports and revolutionise the industry and we're not going to stop.

**DAZN VALUES – THE ‘HOW’ IN WHAT WE DO:**

Agility and creativity fuel growth and innovation, to **Make It Happen.**

Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, **Focusing On Impact.**

Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to **Win As One.**

At DAZN, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values equality and diversity, where everyone can contribute and have their voices heard. This means hiring and developing talent across all races, ethnicities, religions, age groups, sexual orientations, gender identities and abilities.

If you’d like to include a cover letter with your application, please feel free to. Please do not feel you need to apply with a photo or disclose any other information that is not related to your professional experience.

Our aim is to make our hiring processes as accessible for everyone as possible, including providing adjustments for interviews where we can.

We look forward to hearing from you.

description:
**Marketing** **Manager** · **THE** **LUUMA** **FAMILY**

About us  
**THE LUUMA FAMILY** brings together three venues with their own personality: **Luuma, Oyana and Moosa**. Each one has its own identity and experience, but together they form one family and one hospitality brand.We are looking for a **Marketing Manager** who can translate the vision of the family and its three venues into clear, creative and effective marketing actions, and make sure they are brought to life.We are looking for someone with **vision, good judgement and strong execution skills**; someone who doesn’t just come up with ideas, but can turn them into actions and see them through from start to finish.

The *role*  
You will be part of the **THE LUUMA FAMILY support team**, working alongside the Operations, HR, and Finance & Administration teams. You will be responsible for developing and leading the marketing strategy for THE LUUMA FAMILY and its three venues. You will work closely with the **Founders and the Operations Director**, connecting the overall vision of the business with the day-to-day planning and execution of marketing activities.You will lead the marketing agenda across the group, making sure that ideas, campaigns and opportunities are turned into well-planned and well-executed actions.

**Your mission:** to turn the vision of THE LUUMA FAMILY, Luuma, Oyana and Moosa into a clear marketing strategy and calendar, and lead its implementation.

Responsibilities

* Create and develop the overall marketing strategy for **THE LUUMA FAMILY and each of its venues**.
* Create and manage the annual marketing calendar, including campaigns, content, events and commercial activations, ensuring everything is planned in advance and delivered on time.
* Protect and develop the brand identity, visual language and tone of voice of the group and each venue.
* Coordinate external collaborators such as photographers, videographers, designers, agencies and other suppliers.
* Create clear briefs, follow up on projects and ensure the correct delivery of content and campaigns.
* Manage the social media channels, newsletters and online presence of all three venues.
* Identify new opportunities to increase brand awareness, traffic, bookings, revenue and customer loyalty.
* Measure the results of marketing activities and use these insights to improve future campaigns.
* Work closely with Operations, HR and Finance whenever marketing initiatives require coordination between departments.
* Balance long-term brand building with commercial and tactical actions that generate results.

Who we are looking for**Requirements**

* Minimum **2–3 years of experience in marketing**, preferably within hospitality, restaurants, beach clubs, leisure or lifestyle.
* Experience managing campaigns, content and creative suppliers.
* Strong knowledge of social media and common marketing tools such as Meta Business Suite, Canva or similar, email marketing and analytics tools.
* Fluent Spanish and English. Additional languages are a plus.
* Availability to be on-site for key events and important moments, including occasional weekends.

Your profile

* Motivated, energetic and proactive.
* Creative, with strong judgement and a natural feel for hospitality, lifestyle and branding.
* Able to turn ideas into actions and make sure they happen.
* Highly organised, with strong planning and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable taking responsibility and working independently.
* Able to move easily between strategy and hands-on execution.
* Attentive to content, image, communication and detail.
* A strong communicator and team player.
* Passionate about hospitality, restaurants, beach clubs, events and lifestyle.

What we value  
We are not looking for someone who simply creates marketing plans. We are looking for someone who **takes ownership, spots opportunities, brings energy and becomes an active part of THE LUUMA FAMILY**.

Someone who thinks ahead, cares about the details and is also willing to be on the ground when needed to achieve the result we are looking for.  
Someone who understands that great marketing is not just about communication: it is about **creating desire, bringing customers through the door and strengthening the brand experience**.**Think it. Plan it. Make it happen.**

How to apply  
Send your CV and, if available, your portfolio or examples of previous work to **hr@luumafamily.com**, with the subject **“Marketing Manager”**. Tell us briefly why you would like to join **THE LUUMA FAMILY** and why you think you would be a good fit for the role.

title: AI Project Manager
description:
At Sanoma Learning, we all share a deep-rooted passion for education and are committed to support teachers to help all students to reach their potential, so they can be at their best in class. We are proud of the impact we make together across Europe, local as well as international. As our teams and the scope of our impact grows, so do the opportunities for us to learn from each other – across country borders and areas of expertise. With over 3.000 colleagues, we work on seamlessly integrated print, digital and blended learning solutions to help teachers and schools develop the talents of every child. Our people are passionate and committed and always willing to go the extra mile for students, teachers, schools, our shareholders and each other.

We believe that Data and AI can uncover multiple opportunities for education, including both internal efficiencies and new product opportunities; currently AI is a priority theme for Sanoma Learning.

**AI Project Manager**

The AI Project Manager is part of the AI Enablement team – the small central team that makes AI work at Sanoma Learning possible: setting direction, building the foundations, and connecting the many parties involved. The team works as a flexible unit: members take ownership of the initiatives that matter most at a given moment, and capacity is redirected as priorities shift.

Within that team, this role carries a clear centre of gravity: it is the connection point between AI at Sanoma Learning and the outside world, and between the AI team and the functions that own communication and strategy. The role does not replace those functions. It makes sure they have the AI substance, the right experts and the right coordination to do their work well – and it turns what the AI teams do into something that colleagues, customers, partners and the wider education community can understand and engage with.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Data and AI, the AI Project Manager works across operating companies and central functions – Communications, Strategy, M&A, Legal and the product and experimentation teams – and represents the AI agenda in those forums. This role also assumes matrix reporting into the Competence Lead of Project Management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI communication – internal and external**

Acting as the AI team’s counterpart to the Communications function: bringing the content, the context and the experts, and coordinating the AI side of delivery.

* **Own the editorial cycle of the AI update newsletter** – collect input from AI initiatives and opcos, shape the story, manage the calendar and the review loop with Communications.

* **Run the AI webinar and event series** – programme, speakers, preparation of presenters, logistics with the relevant functions, and follow-up.

* **Curate and maintain the AI Hub** – keep it current and usable, agree the content structure with contributing teams, and chase the contributions that make it worth visiting.

* **Coordinate AI content for the external website and corporate channels** – gather and quality-assure input from the AI teams, propose what should be told publicly, and work with Communications, who own publication.

* **Sync a shared communication calendar for AI with communications** – so that announcements, launches, webinars and external moments are sequenced rather than colliding.

**Thought leadership and external presence**

Working with the Strategy function, which owns Sanoma Learning’s thought leadership agenda, to ensure AI is represented with credible substance.

* **Build and manage a pipeline of external speaking opportunities** – identify the conferences and forums worth being at, manage submissions and deadlines, and match the right internal speaker to each.

* **Prepare speakers and material** – coordinate narrative, evidence and rehearsal so that colleagues representing Sanoma Learning externally are well equipped.

* **Drive the production of white papers and publications on AI in education** – coordinate authors, source the evidence from our own initiatives, and run the process to publication with Strategy and Communications.

* **Manage relationships with research institutions and academic partners** – keep the contacts warm, track joint work, and identify where research collaboration strengthens our position.

* **Track the external conversation on AI in education** – what peers, policymakers and researchers are saying – and feed that back into the AI agenda.

**AI partnership and M&A funnel**

Owning the front end of the AI partnership pipeline, feeding the teams that own the decisions and the transactions.

* **Build and maintain the funnel of AI-related partnership and acquisition opportunities** – sourcing, structured overview, status and next steps.

* **Run first-pass screening of candidates** – what they do, how it relates to our AI direction, what a fit would look like – and prepare the material that lets leadership decide what to pursue.

* **Organise the AI-side assessment** – pull in the technical, product, privacy and compliance expertise needed to evaluate an opportunity properly, and consolidate the view.

* **Coordinate with Strategy and M&A** , and with the business owners who would take on the partnership.

* **Maintain the relationship layer with active AI partners and vendors** – cadence, follow-up and internal visibility of what each partnership is delivering.

**Leading AI initiatives and projects**

As a member of a small, flexible team, taking direct ownership of initiatives where capacity and momentum are needed.

* **Lead assigned AI initiatives and projects end to end** – scope, plan, stakeholders, delivery and closure – across the full breadth of the AI agenda.

* **Step into initiatives that need to move** – taking over, unblocking or accelerating work as priorities shift, including topics outside the communication and partnership scope.

* **Bring structure to ambiguous work** – turn broad intentions into a plan with owners, milestones and a decision path.

* **Prepare and facilitate the forums that move decisions forward** – working sessions, steering updates and executive material.

* **Represent the AI Enablement team in cross-functional programmes** where AI is one of several contributing tracks.

**How this role works with others**

Communication and thought leadership are owned by dedicated functions at Sanoma Learning, and this role does not duplicate them. Its value lies in being the AI team’s connection into those functions: supplying substance and expertise, coordinating the AI-side contributors, keeping the AI agenda sequenced and visible, and making sure opportunities are not lost because no one on the AI side was joining the dots. The success measure is that Communications and Strategy are consistently well served by AI – not that AI does their work.

  

**A successful candidate will have the following:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are a strong advantage.

Additional coursework or certification in AI/ML, communications, or digital transformation is a plus.  



**Experience**

* 4+ years of professional experience in project, programme or initiative management in a digital, technology or innovation context, with at least 2 years connected to AI, data or digital transformation topics.

* Demonstrated experience in corporate or B2B communication – for example newsletters, webinars, content platforms, website content or campaign coordination – working with or within a communications function.

* Experience preparing executive-level and external-facing material, and supporting senior colleagues in representing the organisation publicly.

* Exposure to partnership management, vendor evaluation, corporate development or M&A support activities.

* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and business units, preferably in multi-country or federated environments.

* Familiarity with AI concepts and the current AI landscape, sufficient to translate technical work into language a business or public audience understands.

* Hands-on experience with collaboration and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, SharePoint) and with content or intranet platforms.

Experience in education, publishing or EdTech, or with research institutions, is a plus.  



**Skills**

* Excellent written communication in English – able to turn technical and strategic material into clear, engaging content for different audiences.

* Strong stakeholder management, comfortable working as a connector between a specialist team and central functions without owning either side.

* Solid project management skills, able to run several parallel tracks with clarity on ownership, deadlines and status.

* Sound understanding of AI and data concepts, and the curiosity to keep that understanding current.

* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, facilitate alignment and drive decisions across teams.

* Strong sense for what is worth telling externally, and the judgement to know what is not.

* Comfortable with documentation, editorial process and governance that keep recurring communication running reliably.

Collaborative and proactive mindset, with an ability to connect the dots across organisational silos.  



**Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and positive “can-do” attitude, demonstrating initiative and resilience.

* Comfortable operating without formal authority, building influence through reliability and usefulness to others.

* Strong organisational skills, adept at managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

* Flexible and pragmatic – willing to pick up what the team needs at a given moment.

* Data-driven decision-making approach.

* Self-motivated, consistently seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation.

Passionate about the opportunities in the Data and AI space, and about education.  



**About Sanoma Learning**

How do you prepare students for the world, engage their curiosity and inspire them to grow? That is the main question of teachers all around the world. At Sanoma Learning, it has always been our mission to help to find and develop best-in-class answers to this question. If you join us, it means that you embark on an exciting journey to help shape the future of learning for primary, secondary and vocational education. We believe that your journey is our success as a company.
  
  
Sanoma Learning is a leading K12 European learning company, operating in 12 countries. Our learning products and services enable and support teachers and schools to develop the talents of every child to reach their potential. By offering printed and digital learning content, as well as digital learning and teaching platforms for primary, secondary and vocational education, we want to grow our positive impact on learning across Europe. With over 3000 employees, we help shape the future of education for 25+ million of students.
  
  
So, are you ready to start your journey to help shape the future of learning and help teachers to support all students to reach their potential?
  
  
*Sanoma Learning is an equal opportunity employer; we are committed to inclusion and diversity, ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics.*

description:

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **Center for Social Innovation and Sustainability** is looking for an **Academic Director (Part-time)** to join its team!

Every story begins with a purpose, and ours has always been about people. Founded in 1973, IE University has continuously raised the bar to drive positive change through education. We believe education is more than a path to professional success; it is a catalyst for personal transformation and meaningful impact.

At IE University, we place people and their potential at the center of everything we do, empowering individuals to become extraordinary. We encourage bold thinking and foster a culture where innovation, curiosity, and courage lead to real-world impact. Together, we create an environment where talent thrives, and ideas shape the future.

**Our mission**

We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

**Our Purpose**

To foster positive change.

**Values**

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset

We are looking for a person to join a full-time position in **Madrid - María de Molina 31**

Responsibilities:

**Your role as an Academic Director (Part Time) will involve:**

* **About the Center and the role**
  ---------------------------------

  The Center operates as a think and do tank within IE University. It works with companies, corporate foundations and international institutions on applied research, impact measurement, social innovation awards, learning programs and advisory projects. Its work is measured by the real impact it generates in society.

  The Center is led by its Director, and by an Executive Director. The Academic Director will complete this leadership team. The role is responsible for the high-quality content and methodology of all Center outputs and serves as the Center’s link with IE faculty and external experts.

  The position requires a 50 percent dedication and at least two days per week on campus, with flexibility to be agreed. The Academic Director reports to the Director of the Center.

  **Responsibilities**
  --------------------

  + **Content conceptualisation and supervision in execution.** Lead the content of proposals across all project types, from applied research and impact measurement to programs, awards and learning initiatives: frame the problem, define the research question/social impact value proposition, build the theory of change and design deliverables that will have a real impact. Ensure methodological rigor and practical relevance throughout execution and provide final content review for outputs.
  + **Intellectual representation and expert network.** Act as the Center’s academic voice with partners, students and beneficiaries, and represent it in forums alongside or on behalf of the Director. Identify and engage IE faculty and external experts for each project in coordination with the Engagement Director or supported by other team members when necessary.
  + **Centre’s capacity:** Strengthen the centre’s methodological capabilities through continuous updating of knowledge, cutting-edge frameworks, templates, feedback and training.

Qualifications:

**To thrive in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:**

title: Managing Editor
description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

* 1-on-1 management, ensuring clear workflows, and providing individual feedback.

* Leading and guiding the team to foster growth, inspire creativity, and reach new audiences.

* Taking a hands-on approach to initiate key content-creation initiatives.

* Building and optimizing a successful content-driven conversion funnel, ensuring that storytelling, formats, distribution, and audience insights work together to drive measurable conversions.

* Proficiency in English. Any other extra language is a plus.
* +5 years of experience working for a newsroom, content agency, creative agency, or digital media property.
* Strong leadership skills with a minimum of 2 years of team management experience.
* Deep passion for journalism, especially at the local level, social media, and digital marketing.
* Expertise in media mapping and the ability to collaborate with external partners (advertising agencies, media agencies, TV/Animation companies).
* Digital fluency and hands-on knowledge of the current social media landscape, including platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, etc.
* Ability to inspire creative teams and customers, strong presentation skills.
* Data-driven and business-savvy with superb writing skills and creative flair.
* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.
* Ability to convert content creators' economy into growth opportunities.
* Team player attitude.
* Additionally, proficiency in using WordPress, familiarity with Photoshop, Canva, and knowledge of other image/video editing software is preferred. Powerful media network contacts and connections will be highly appreciated.

  

**Why You´ll Love It Here**

  

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
* Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
* Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.

* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.

title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**

We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post-production, creating interviews, talking-head content, b-roll, and studio shoots for company-wide communications and campaigns.

As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high-quality visual content in a fast-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.

You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end-to-end, including scheduling interviews, talking-head sessions, b-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.

title: Director of Marketing
description:
#### **About Primordial Labs**

We're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. Our core product, Anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. We’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.

#### **The Opportunity**

Primordial Labs is hiring a Marketing Director to own marketing for a fast-growing defense technology company. We are seeking a strategic, creative, hands-on Marketing Director to build Primordial Labs' marketing function from the ground up.

You will own the marketing function end-to-end, including positioning and narrative, brand building, product marketing, events and field presence, and social media content. You will work directly with leadership, business development, and engineering to translate deeply technical capability into a story that resonates with operators, program offices, primes, partners, and investors. We’re looking for someone who can move fast and work multiple workstreams at once, creating marketing content with little direction.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Build and own Primordial Labs' marketing strategy, translating business strategy into a plan across brand, product marketing, and communications
* Build the marketing strategy that enables our Business Strategy; set priorities, budget, and metrics, and present KPIs to leadership
* Evolve the brand across the website, graphics, videos, events, and social media
* Produce critical marketing materials for customers and partners: capability briefs, demo videos, white papers, case studies, one-pagers, etc.
* Write blogs, press releases, capability briefs, one-pagers, website copy, and talking points
* Own the company's social presence, publishing several times per week
* Design and run marketing campaigns around product releases, demonstrations, trade shows, contract wins, company milestones, etc.with minimal direction
* Direct designers, writers, video producers, and agencies as needed. Write clear briefs, review work, and hold quality and deadlines.
* Own the marketing infrastructure: website, content engine, marketing automation integration, analytics, and KPI reporting
* Define the marketing org we need over the next 24 months

#### **About You**

* 10+ years of marketing experience, including 2+ years leading a marketing function or team
* Demonstrated experience building a marketing function from the ground up, with a portfolio of work you personally owned and can walk us through in detail
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving, lean environment
* Exceptional writing and storytelling ability, with track record of personally producing high-quality marketing content under tight timelines, with samples available
* Experience marketing a technical product to a sophisticated buyer, with the ability to learn a complex domain quickly and speak about it credibly
* Experience directing contractors, agencies, and creative specialists, including decisions on what to keep in-house and what to outsource
* Strong command of modern marketing tooling, including leveraging AI tools where appropriate

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

Defense experience is desirable, not required. We would rather hire an exceptional marketer willing to learn the domain than a domain expert who cannot build a function.

* Graphic Design, layout, and/or video production skills.
* Experience marketing to DoD, government, or national security customers.
* Familiarity with autonomous systems, robotics, AI, or human-machine teaming technologies
* Experience as an early marketing hire at a startup or defense technology company

**Important Qualification Note:** *Due to the nature of our work and federal compliance requirements, this position strictly requires U.S. Citizenship and current residency within the United States. Please note that Permanent Residency (Green Card status) or visa sponsorship cannot satisfy these specific regulatory requirements.*

#### **Compensation**

Compensation for this position includes a target base salary of $175,000 - $250,000 annually, with the specific figure determined by the candidate's experience level.

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation and are happy to explain how we determine our salary ranges, just ask!

#### **Our Benefits**

* Beyond a Competitive Salary, we provide a significant equity stake, aligning your growth with ours.
* 100% Remote: This role is fully remote, open to residents across the US. We believe that talent knows no borders (well, except for the US in this case!).
* Comprehensive Health Coverage: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans so you and your family can stay healthy and worry free.
* Retirement Planning: Plan for tomorrow with our 401(k) package, complete with a generous 6% company match.
* Generous DTO: Our generous Discretionary Time off (DTO) policy is all about helping you take the breaks you deserve and live your healthiest, most fulfilling life.
* Elite Technology Package: Enjoy an elite technology package to make your work effortless and efficient.

#### **Our Interview Process**

Our interview process is designed to be thorough and respectful of your time. It typically includes:

* Conversation with the People Team: Lets get to know one another first!
* Interview: A 45-minute discussion about relevant marketing concepts and your past experience.
* Portfolio Overview: We’ll invite you to walk us through a portfolio of your work. We’re interested in seeing the 'how' behind your results—specifically your strategic process, the creative execution, and the data-driven outcomes of your past campaigns.
* Team Interviews: Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. During this stage, you’ll meet your prospective peers to discuss our team dynamics, project workflows, and how we work together to win.

We are committed to a low-stress interview experience—no trick questions or brain teasers!

Primordial Labs is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone. Discrimination and harassment have no place here. We firmly believe that a diverse team enriches our problem-solving capabilities, sparks greater creativity, and ultimately leads to a better product and a more vibrant company.

We understand that great talent comes from various paths and that passion and transferable skills are invaluable. At Primordial Labs, what truly matters is your ability to make an impact, your dedication to our mission, and your capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative atmosphere. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where you can contribute your unique talents, expand your skills, and learn continuously. If you’re driven to make a real impact, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who we are**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

**About the Role**:

Frontiers is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined product, platform, or workflow area within our publishing ecosystem. The exact domain — submission, peer review, production, partnerships, AI, or another area — will be confirmed at the offer stage based on where the business need and the candidate's strengths best align. This description sets the bar and shape of the role common to all our Senior PM positions, so that candidates can be assessed once and matched to the right opening.

You will own your product end to end: understanding user and business needs, defining the roadmap, working with engineering, design and operational stakeholders to ship it, and being accountable for the outcomes it produces. You will operate within Frontiers' one-platform strategy — favouring shared, scalable workflows over bespoke, one-off solutions — regardless of which domain you land in.

You will not wait for a perfect brief. You will spot the problem, make a call with the data you have, and go find the rest. We want someone who treats a blocker as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to pause.

Key Responsibilities

* Roadmap ownership: Define and drive the roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, business priorities, and platform constraints into a clear, sequenced plan.
* Requirements discipline: Gather, document, and reconcile requirements from multiple stakeholders — internal teams, partners, or end users — into a coherent, scalable product definition rather than a pile of one-off requests.
* Cross-team delivery: Work with and through engineering, design, and other product teams to ship your roadmap, tracking dependencies and resolving conflicts without necessarily having direct authority over every team involved.
* User- and stakeholder-facing discovery: Engage directly with the people who use or depend on your product — authors, editors, reviewers, partners, or internal teams — to uncover real underlying needs and validate that proposed solutions solve them.
* Creative, pragmatic solutioning: Where requirements conflict with simplicity or scale, propose solutions — configuration over customisation, shared workflows over bespoke branches — that satisfy the intent without fragmenting the platform.
* Evidence-led decisions: Steer your roadmap with data: define the metrics that matter for your area, track them, and show what you measured, what you changed, and what moved. Be ready to change course when the data says you were wrong.
* Quality and risk ownership: Hold the bar for whatever your product area delivers, and manage risk transparently when timelines, dependencies, or stakeholder expectations are under pressure. Define acceptance criteria, test with real users before release, and own post-launch quality.
* Product vision: Set a clear vision for your product area and connect it to Frontiers' one-platform strategy, so every roadmap choice traces back to a purpose.
* Business outcome ownership: Build and defend the business case for your product. Set the investment, expected return and payback, and answer for whether it was worth it.
* Team leadership: Lead your squad of engineers, designers and analysts toward shared goals. Coach, set direction and raise the bar, even without formal reporting lines.
* Managing up: Give the Head of Product and senior leadership regular, candid updates on progress, risks and trade-offs. Bring a recommendation with each decision you need.
* AI and automation: Find where AI agents and automation can remove manual work or improve outcomes in your area. Then scope, ship and measure them.
* Launch and adoption: Take your product from idea through launch to adoption. Plan rollout, train users, then track usage and iterate until the outcome moves.
* Resourceful problem-solving: When data, access or alignment is missing, say what you need, from whom and how you will get it. Keep moving in the meantime.

  
**Requirements**  

* Clarity of thought: You think critically and bring structure and clear rationale to ambiguous, cross-domain problems.
* Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, ideally including ownership of a multi-stakeholder, operations-heavy, or platform-level product.
* Requirements practitioner: Proven ability to gather, document, and unify requirements from multiple demanding stakeholders into a coherent product definition.
* Technical literacy: Comfortable discussing workflows, data, and system design with engineers, and reading the evidence behind a problem, without needing to be a domain specialist on day one.
* User-centric design: A track record of turning a complex process into an experience that different types of users can complete with confidence.
* Cross-team influence: Experience delivering through other teams and aligning multiple roadmaps toward a shared outcome, including without direct authority over every team involved.
* Outcomes: You can point to what you measured, what you changed, and what moved as a result of your product work.
* Ownership and agency: You take responsibility without being asked. When you hit an obstacle, you ask "how do I get this done?" and propose a path. You treat mistakes as information and move on quickly.
* Domain exposure: Background in academic publishing, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant B2B products, or AI/ML products is a plus, but strong learning agility can substitute for direct domain experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
* Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

*Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.*
