At **Fresenius Medical Care**, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110,000 employees.

As a part of **Global Functions**, our **Real Estate department** is driving transformation through our **FME Reignite** strategy, which focuses on innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth. Our values are the foundation of our culture:

* **We Care** for our patients, each other, and our communities.
* **We Connect** across teams and borders to deliver excellence together.
* **We Commit** to doing things the right way—growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation.

**Purpose of the role**

The Regional Lead is responsible for end-to-end real estate and corporate security execution across an assigned international region.

This role ensures the effective delivery of real estate, facilities, and security programs across a diverse portfolio of offices, clinics, laboratories, and manufacturing sites. Operating within a highly outsourced model, the leader drives execution through third-party partners while maintaining strong governance over cost, quality, and risk.

The role serves as the primary partner to Country Managers and regional business leaders, aligning real estate and security strategies with business priorities and local market dynamics.

This role reports to the Head of International Real Estate & Corporate Security.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Regional Portfolio Execution & Strategy Delivery**

* Own execution of real estate portfolio strategy across the assigned international region, ensuring alignment with global objectives and local business needs.
* Direct site-level real estate activities, including transactions, space planning, design & construction delivery, and facilities operations.
* Ensure effective implementation of footprint strategies, including expansion, consolidation, and optimization initiatives.
* Monitor regional market conditions and provide insights to inform portfolio decisions and risk management.

**Business Partnership & Regional Leadership**

* Serve as the primary partner to Country Managers and regional business leaders, aligning real estate and security solutions with business priorities.
* Build strong relationships across functions to ensure alignment and responsiveness to regional needs.
* Act as the key escalation point for regional issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal business disruption.

**Outsourced Delivery Model & Vendor Management**

* Lead delivery through a highly outsourced model, managing brokers, construction project managers (CPMs), facilities management providers, and security vendors.
* Establish and enforce vendor performance standards, SLAs, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure consistent delivery quality, cost efficiency, and compliance across all third-party providers.
* Drive continuous improvement in vendor performance and delivery outcomes.

**Corporate Security Execution**

* Oversee corporate security execution across the region, including physical security measures, vendor oversight, and incident response coordination.
* Ensure adherence to corporate security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Support regional risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies for identified threats.
* Coordinate with the Corporate Security CoE on standards, intelligence, and crisis response.

**Risk, Compliance & Performance Management**

* Ensure compliance with local, national, and international regulations across all sites.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to real estate, facilities, and security operations.
* Track and report on regional performance metrics, including cost, delivery timelines, and service quality.
* Provide regular updates to senior leadership on portfolio performance, risks, and opportunities.

**Global Alignment & CoE Partnership**

* Partner with Global Real Estate and Corporate Security Centers of Excellence (CoEs) to ensure alignment with standards, governance, and reporting requirements.
* Support implementation of global initiatives, tools, and best practices across the region.
* Provide regional insights to inform global strategy and continuous improvement.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and develop a regional team of real estate, facilities, and/or security professionals (e.g., transaction managers, FM SMEs).
* Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and service excellence.
* Collaborate closely with global functional leaders (Transactions, Design & Construction, FM, Security, CoEs).
* Serve as a key member of the international leadership team, contributing to strategy, planning, and governance.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Real Estate, or related field required

* 12–15+ years of experience in international real estate, facilities, and/or corporate security leadership
* Master’s Degree preferred
* Proven experience operating in complex, multi-country environments
* Strong experience managing outsourced delivery models and third-party vendors
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior business leaders and influence decision-making
* Experience managing multi-asset portfolios (offices, clinics, labs, manufacturing)
* Strong understanding of global regulatory environments and risk management
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive execution in decentralized environments
* This position requires approximately 25% to 50% travel.

**Our Offer For You:**

There is a lot you can discover at **Fresenius Medical Care**, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.

* Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
* Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
* A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
* A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
* The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Director of Partnerships and Technology Alliances
description:

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you'll build the partnerships function that scales our curriculum—bringing the world's leading content providers, technology vendors, and highest-profile instructors onto DataCamp so millions of learners can build the skills that matter.

* Experience as an educator or curriculum developer in technical education.

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you'll love being on our team:

* **Exciting Challenges** – Tackle some of the most important educational challenges in Data & AI.
* **Work with the Best Instructors** – Partner with top-tier instructors from leading organizations like Microsoft, Hugging Face, AWS, and more.
* **Competitive Compensation** – We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.

* **Global Culture** – Join a team that values international collaboration.

Our competitive compensation package offers additional benefits. On top of your salary you will also receive extra legal benefits such as best-in-class medical insurance including dental and vision. Depending on your location additional benefits might be available to you.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**About Board of Innovation**

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Tech Lead to own the technical side of our most demanding AI builds, end to end. You step in the moment a client request lands, shape the scope and the solution with the team, turn it into an architecture and a build plan, lead the engineering through project delivery, and be the client's technical counterpart until the system runs in their environment.

This is a senior, on-project engineering role. Our builds typically run for several months, with three to five BOI engineers, inside the client's own cloud environment. You make the technical decisions within your projects, running one flagship build close to full-time or two or three smaller builds at once, depending on the portfolio. You report directly to our Engineering Director.

**What You'll Do**

You lead the technical delivery of enterprise AI builds, from agentic systems and LLM-powered services to the platforms around them, deployed into clients' own environments. The work runs in four strands.

Shape the solution. When a request lands on one of your accounts, you work out with the team what to build, how, with whom and in how many weeks. You write the technical side of the proposal and defend the estimate. Occasionally you do the same for a new deal, when a pitch needs an engineer who can credibly say how it will be built.

Lead the build. You own the architecture, make and document the decisions that shape it, review the team's work, and keep client stakeholders aligned on progress, trade-offs and risks. The engineers on the project look to you for direction, and you give it.

Build where it matters. When the critical path needs it, you build it yourself, whether that's a prototype that proves an approach in days, a hard integration, or a fix nobody else can land. What you ship is production-grade.

Carry the client. You're the technical voice in the room. You explain what we're building and why to people who don't write code, you earn their confidence that we can deliver, and you handle the realities of a large organization, from approvals and platform teams to security reviews and politics. You know when to push, when to work around, and when to escalate.

Between builds, you work on the internal tooling and templates that make every BOI engineer faster.

**What You Bring**

Experience. You have 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least two in which you technically led a build and the engineers on it, ideally for clients who were not technical themselves. You've taken systems from a design on paper to production in someone else's environment, and you know what that costs.

Applied AI depth. Your core strength is applied AI engineering, meaning agents, tool use, retrieval, MCP, evals and the orchestration around them. You've shipped LLM-based systems into production and have opinions about reliability, cost and evaluation that came from being burned. Our Engineering Director covers the deep ML side, so the best complement is someone whose instincts sit in systems, agents and delivery.

Engineering fundamentals. Python, CI/CD, testing, review discipline and infrastructure-as-code are second nature, and you use AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, Codex and MCP-based workflows fluently, with the guardrails that keep generated code production-grade. Real production cloud experience, Azure preferred, and experience deploying inside locked-down enterprise environments are a big plus.

Communication and judgement. You can explain an architecture to a VP in five minutes and hold a client room without a project manager running interference for you. You're creative in finding a path when the obvious one is blocked, you build trust fast, and you know what to decide yourself, what to flag, and when to escalate.

People management and hiring sit with the Engineering Director. You mentor the engineers on your projects, and the role can grow toward team-level leadership over time.

**How You Work**

You treat a build as yours. You make decisions and own them, keep the people who depend on you informed in writing, briefly and regularly, and ask for help early when the commercial or people side of a project needs it.

You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain, a new client culture and a new set of constraints, and you work in the open with strategists, designers and consultants.

The field moves quickly, and so do we. You pull in what's useful, bring it back to the team, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

**Contract & Setup**

You're based in Lisbon or elsewhere in Portugal, where our engineering team sits. We're open to permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements, and the final setup depends on your situation and local compliance requirements. We'd like you to start in November 2026.

**Interested?**

Apply with your CV and a short note on a build you technically led, what went wrong, and what you'd do differently. Bonus points for something we can actually look at.

title: Freelance Account Director
description:
**Job Overview**

**We are looking for an experience Freelance Influencer Account Director who have availability to join us ASAP.**

The Account Director ensures the smooth production of campaigns – from briefing design and creative to managing budgets and a team.

The candidates would be driven by producing the best work to the best standards, and possess the ability to lead, develop, and empower a team to be motivated to achieve this.

There is a strong culture at BDB built on the four values of quality, innovation, collaboration, and integrity.

**Responsibilities**

* Managing, growing and training a team of account handlers and multiple clients (both retained and project based).
* Developing relationships with senior clients and growing the accounts on both creatively and financially.
* Leading, planning and overseeing the work and output on your assigned accounts.
* Inputting to new business pitches.
* Planning and forecasting for your team and accounts.
* Training and developing the team ensures the detail of the campaign is exemplary and processes are efficient.
* Negotiates contracts and fees with marketing directors and client procurement personnel.
* Manages the work, performance and professional development of team members.
* Leading and inspiring those outside of the core team, including creative teams and those in other agencies working on the same account.
* Report key financial and team data to the agency’s senior leadership, finance and human resources departments.
* Maintains a detailed awareness of relevant market trends affecting their accounts, and developments in the wider advertising and communications industry.

**Skills & Attributes**

* **1 + years experience in the role of Account Director and strong experience with end to end influencer marketing**
* Significant experience in professional client relationship management.
* Ensuring Account Management 101 at all touchpoints: excellent attention to detail, high client satisfaction, process implementation, financial management, and excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ideally has experience working on influencer campaigns but will need to demonstrate social first thinking.
* The ability to plan and strategise at a senior level.
* Vision to develop teams and grow business.
* A persuasive and confident approach to realising bold creative thinking.
* Effective team management and pastoral capabilities.
* Keen interest in digital content and evolution and industry trends/news.

**About Billion Dollar Boy**

Billion Dollar Boy (BDB) is a global creator agency, using industry-leading tech solutions to deliver integrated, creator-led advertising and end-to-end campaign management. Founded in 2014, Billion Dollar Boy was among the first global influencer agencies and now has offices in London, New York and New Orleans.

Since its inception, BDB has partnered with some of the world’s leading brands - including Heineken, King, Nintendo, PepsiCo and L’Oréal - connecting them with more than 10,000 vetted content creators.

BDB client campaigns have been awarded at the Cannes Lions, Influencer Marketing Awards, Webby Awards, Shortys, The Drum Awards and Adweek.  
  
**Our Culture**

Our mission is to redefine advertising by reflecting culture through the voices of creators, where creativity is democratized, and technology is the driving force behind impact. We champion equity and inclusion, and believe that diversity sparks creativity, problem-solving, and well-being. Along with fostering these values, BDB is committed to being the most innovative creator marketing agency in the world through initiatives like FiveTwoNine and Muse.

**Our Values**

We believe one of the biggest issues advertising agencies face is reputational. Our vision is to change that by setting a new standard of advertising with a greater social purpose, where creativity is democratised, and technology drives efficiency and effectiveness.

Billion Dollar Boy has identified industry problems and potential solutions, leading to a set of **Future Behaviours** that should be adopted by every agency to positively change advertising as a whole:

* **Work with brands, but on behalf of people** - Brands are clients, but agencies must prioritise people’s interests, educating brands on consumer importance and acting on behalf of the people.
* **Seek out less heard voices, act upon what they tell you** - Diverse opinions and perspectives improve work and the world. Agencies must actively listen to and act on a broad range of voices.
* **Be fair to everyone, then you’ll have nothing to hide** - Agencies should ensure objective and transparent reward structures to promote equality.
* **Treat your clients like friends and employees like best friends** - Clients provide opportunities, but employees turn them into work. Agencies must prioritise employees' wellbeing.
* **Solve problems with a curious mind** - Creativity involves original ideas. Agencies should explore unproven solutions and take risks for better outcomes, even if things aren’t broken.
* **Empower employees with a framework for freedom** - Provide supportive structures without restrictions, allowing employees to make decisions and control their career progression within clear business parameters.

**Equal Opportunities**

We encourage employees to be open and confident and appreciate that every member of the team makes a vital difference.

Billion Dollar Boy embraces equality, diversity and inclusion and will seek to promote these benefits in all of our business activities.

When recruiting new employees or when affording our current employees with opportunities for promotion, it means that we will:

* Recruit, develop and retain the most talented people, regardless of their background and make best use of their talents;
* Not discriminate unlawfully against any person;
* Select the best person for the job in terms of qualifications and abilities.
* This sets out our approach to equal opportunities and the avoidance of discrimination at work.
* A part of what we offer at BDB is a considerate suite of competitive benefits, which will be discussed with you throughout the interview process

**Our Perks**

* 25 days annual leave
* x1 additional day of annual leave per year of service up to a max. of 5

Technical Solution Architect - Data Center Networking & WAN routingThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**Technical Solution Architect - Data Center Networking & WAN routing**

**About The Role:**  
HPE Networking simplifies networking through innovative, software-defined products and solutions for cloud, AI, and data center environments. HPE Networking develops industry-leading technologies that are ever more software-defined, helping to answer the most challenging issues in connectivity. Digital transformation is everywhere, with technologies such as Multi-Cloud, Cybersecurity, Automation, IoT, AI, Machine Learning, and 5G driving the next waves of innovation.  
  
Technical solution architects are part of the HPE Networking GTM team and have the primary responsibility to partner with sales specialists, sales engineers, account managers, PLM and engineering to drive technical sales activities, with a particular focus on those opportunities involving new products and emerging technologies.

Technical solution architects possess in-depth, hands-on expertise with HPE's products, solutions as well as other open-source or 3rd party technologies which complement HPE’s vision for networking. Technical solution architects have an excellent knowledge of the broader industry and act as a trusted advisors to our customers, educating them on evolving trends in networking and how HPE’s products and solutions can help them achieve their business goals.

For this specific role we’re looking for an exceptional technical leader and evangelist to support HPE’s customer engagements around Enterprise solutions, with a special focus on data center networks and WAN routing.

The technical solution architect will build and maintain close relationships with existing and potential customers – with the aim to become a trusted advisor / consultant from the initial engagement to a successful closing of the opportunity. This role requires deep technical expertise, experience, creative problem-solving, and strong customer engagement skills to influence and shape breakthrough deals and innovative use cases.

If you have over-the-top technical capability and curiosity; if you can influence both technical and business partners by translating business goals and challenges into technical solutions while differentiating HPE from competing solutions; if your interpersonal and high-impact presentation skills evoke passion and confidence; if you’re a born problem-solver that loves to get into the details and have a burning desire to answer the hard problems in a constantly evolving, results-oriented industry - HPE Networking is the place for you!

**What You’ll Do:**

* Act as a technical architect early in complex sales cycles, working independently or with Sales Engineers, to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions for both new and existing data center and/or WAN routing opportunities.
* Act as a trusted adviser to, and build and maintain close relationships with, (i) HPE sales engineering, sales specialist and account management teams that support our customer base, (ii) HPE channel partners, and (iii) HPE cooperate functions such as Product Line Management and Engineering.

* Support sales engineering teams with understanding customer requirements, providing guidance in the design of solutions, delivering technical deep-dive presentations and demonstrations, contributing to Proof-of-Concept tests, presenting/training at seminars, and assisting with tender responses.
* Become a go-to expert and trusted advisor for the HPE sales engineering community on HPE’s product portfolio and automation solutions, as well as the wider industry trends and competitive solutions, in your area of focus.
* Influence technical strategy within HPE Networking by building, maintaining and disseminating thought leadership in networking innovations and industry trends.
* Speak at internal and external conferences, HPE networking and innovation days, HPE Tech Jams, Network Operator Groups and other industry events.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to junior technologists and sales engineering teams.

**Skills you need to have:**

* Proven track record of working in a customer-facing pre-sale’s role selling networking equipment or end-user experience in design / architecture / vendor selection.
* Exceptional hands-on skills and/or and the ability to support complex proof of concept tests with potentially new products and emerging technologies.
* Excellent inter-personal skills are critical as you will work in virtual, multi-national teams, with little supervision, and diverse demands from many stakeholders.
* You must be able to have a credible (technical) interaction with Enterprise and Service Provider Engineering teams about the industry, technology, and HPE products and solutions in Data Center and WAN technologies to a very detailed technical Level.
* Outstanding communication skills with the ability to communicate to a variety of audiences, both internal and external, and at all levels, from deeply technical to executive level technical decision-makers. English verbal and written/presentation skills are mandatory, other major European language skills are an advantage.
* Comfortable with extensive international travel to visit with customers, partners and account teams.

**Technical knowledge you need to have:**

* In depth understanding of customer’s business objectives and application of Enterprise Datacenter/Private Cloud and WAN routing solutions across various customer segments and verticals.
* Proven track record in designing Data Center and WAN architectures including EVPN/VXLAN, CLOS fabrics, and underlay designs.
* Expert level knowledge and deep hands-on experience with routing protocols such as of TCP/IP, BGP, ISIS, OSPF, Multicast, Layer-2/3 VPN’s, Carrier Ethernet, MPLS traffic engineering (RSVP, SR-TE, SRv6), SDN overlays (EVPN/VXLAN, MP-BGP), Network Fabrics and DCI solutions.
* Familiarity with major networking silicon, hardware platforms and related software (e.g., Juniper/HPE, Nokia, Arista, Cisco, etc.).
* Outstanding knowledge of network management, service provisioning, automation, network monitoring and telemetry interfaces such as Netconf/REST APIs, YANG, OpenConfig, gRPC and how these apply to modern Data Center and WAN routing architectures is essential. Experience with HPE management solutions such as Apstra, Routing Director or equivalent competitive products is an advantage.
* Experience with programming/scripting (Python, APIs, JSON etc.) to enable solution integration and automation.
* Extensive knowledge of Containers and Container related technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, as well as familiarity with Linux operating systems.

**Other Information:**

* The location for this role is the Greater London area
* Typically, 20~30% of working time is spend on (international) travel

title: Director, Promotional Review & Labeling Services
description:

The **Director, Promotional Review & Labeling Services** is responsible for:

* Acting as lead for Regulatory role during Promotion Review Committee (PRC) meetings and overseeing the promotional review process, as well as other promotion related processes for assigned brands or therapeutic categories.

* Providing guidance on risk to the PRC and if need be, elevating the risk to their manager/line manager within the client.

* Attend prioritization discussions for the assigned PRC.

* Provide regulatory guidance regarding advertising and promotional materials, new campaigns and launch strategies.

* Clarify rationale and represent regulatory comments on review materials during live PRC meetings.

* Monitor US regulatory promotional environment by staying up to date on FDA regulations and guidances.
* Review of untitled and warning letters to pharmaceutical companies issued by OPDP, APLB, Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH), Federal Trade Commission (FTC), National Advertising Division (NDA) or other governing bodies.

* Proven ability to provide strategic direction and innovative, forward thinking regulatory guidance and analyze and interpret efficacy and safety data.
* Working knowledge of FDA and Pharmaceutical regulatory and compliance guidelines on advertising and promotion, including product launches.
* Deep understanding of the advertising/creative development process.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical review and approval process.
* Experience in leading activities necessary for promotional OPDP submissions.
* Experience with using new and social medial platforms for promotion of prescription drugs in the US.
Proficiency in computer applications and configuration, including Microsoft Office, Adobe Acrobat. Proficiency in Veeva Vault PromoMats or other electronic review platforms.  

  

**Educational Requirements**

A Bachelor's Degree is required, focus in Medical, Science, Marketing, Business or Communications, a PharmD is preferred.  

  

**Experience Requirements**

* 7+ years of related experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry is required. May consider related experience from healthcare advertising agency.
* Functional experience in regulatory advertising and promotion required.
* Previous experience in medical advertising and promotional review, marketing operations, sales or communications preferred.

Strong project and process management experience is required, in pharmaceutical industry is preferred.

title: Senior Manager, Cloud Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

The Center for Geospatial Solutions (CGS) is a self-sustaining nonprofit enterprise. Founded to help bridge the gap between policy and practice, our mission is to enable people and the planet to meet the pace of change by expanding access to new technologies that power more sustainable and equitable outcomes.

We are a fully remote team of award-winning professionals with decades of applied expertise and end-to-end GIS capabilities. By embracing whole-system thinking and state-of-the-art technology, we enable partners across public, private, and nonprofit sectors to tackle complex, real-world challenges—like housing affordability, ecosystem conservation, water management, and sustainable infrastructure—with greater clarity.

Our work liberates and connects key information, creates nuanced pictures of complex situations, and makes land, water, and social data easier to use, understand, and act on. We use tools like satellite data and artificial intelligence to deliver insights for impact.

At CGS, we believe that technology can be a tool for positive change. We are dedicated to building a diverse team that represents the communities and systems we live and work in. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity, and lived experiences, and know a more inclusive team makes us a stronger organization.

**About the Lincoln Institute of Land Policy**

The Lincoln Institute of Land Policy seeks to improve quality of life through the effective use, taxation, and stewardship of land. A nonprofit, private operating foundation whose origins date to 1946, the Lincoln Institute researches and recommends creative, nonpartisan approaches to land as a solution to economic, social, and environmental challenges. Through education, training, publications, and events, we integrate theory and practice to inform public policy decisions worldwide. We organize our work around three impact areas: land and water; land and fiscal systems; and land and communities. We envision a world where cities and regions prosper and benefit from coordinated land use planning and public finance; where communities thrive from efficient and equitable allocation of limited land resources; and where stewardship of land and water resources ensures a livable future. We work globally, with locations in Cambridge, Massachusetts; Washington, DC; Phoenix, Arizona; and Beijing, China.

**Position Overview:**

The Center for Geospatial Solutions (CGS) is seeking a Senior Manager, Cloud Architecture to serve as the lead backend and cloud architect for a complex, multi-year federal program, in addition to working on a second program focused on water reservoir system analysis and data interoperability.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Data Engineering, the Senior Manager, Cloud Architecture will serve as the technical and managerial lead for backend development on a federal program, dedicating most of their time to this work. Their remaining time will aid other CGS projects, where this role will contribute in shaping technical strategy and system design across programs. Under the guidance of Data Engineering and Science leadership, they will define scalable backend architecture, shared cloud services, and production systems that support data ingestion, metadata and discovery, large-scale geospatial processing, model execution, quality assurance and validation, and deliver data and services to users and partners, translating program requirements into technical strategy and standards that can extend beyond a single program.

This is a hands-on engineering role that combines backend software development, cloud architecture, platform engineering, DevOps, security, and cost optimization. This role will oversee a small team of backend developers, providing technical direction, empowerment, and mentorship to the team. The successful candidate will work closely with data scientists, AI engineers, GIS professionals, project managers, and external partners to turn complex technical workflows into maintainable, observable, reproducible, and well-governed systems.

**What You Will Do:**

**Federal Backend Architecture and Technical Delivery**

* Responsible for backend and cloud engineering work on a federal program, coordinating closely with technical leads, project manager, partner organizations, and federal stakeholders.
* Translate program milestones, analytical workflows, user needs, performance requirements, and partner interfaces into technical architecture, implementation plans, and estimates, documenting decisions and progress where needed.
* Identify architectural dependencies, performance constraints, delivery risks, and technical debt early; recommend practical options and tradeoffs to project and technical leadership.
* Design modular backend architecture that connects data ingestion, cataloging, geospatial processing, machine learning, quality assurance, metadata and discovery, and data or service delivery.
* Define service boundaries, APIs, data schemas, workflow patterns, and integration contracts that allow components developed by multiple teams and partners to work together reliably.
* Build shared platform components and integration layers that reduce duplicative, one-off pipelines and aid reuse across regions, analytical methods, and future CGS projects.
* Design and implement secure, scalable cloud architectures for large geospatial datasets, distributed processing, machine learning, databases, APIs, and backend services.
* Select appropriate combinations of containers, batch computing, serverless services, workflow orchestration, managed databases, and other cloud capabilities based on workload requirements.
* Contribute technical estimates, architecture narratives, implementation plans, progress reporting, and documentation required for a complex federally funded program.

**Technical Collaboration & Team Management**

* Directly supervise and empower backend data development staff, overseeing their day-to-day work, performance and professional growth.
* Delegate and manage backend implementation work across team to ensure work is scoped appropriately and aligned with overall envisioned architecture.
* Work with leadership to establish cloud and backend engineering practices that are reproducible across projects.
* Communicate technical options, risks, cost implications, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.

**Backend Software Engineering and Systems Integration**

* Design and oversee the implementation of production-quality backend services, APIs, data-access layers, workflow services, and reusable software components using Python or another appropriate language.
* Build services that enhance functions such as data submission and ingestion, metadata management, job scheduling and status, geospatial processing, model outputs, validation status, search and discovery, and data delivery.
* Work with relational and spatial databases, object storage, queues and event systems, caching, API gateways, authentication and authorization, and other backend infrastructure.
* Evaluate when to build, adapt open-source technologies, or use managed services based on mission needs, delivery timelines, security, maintainability, and total cost.

**Cloud Infrastructure Management**

* Provision and manage compute, object storage, databases, networking, identity and access management, secrets, logging, and related cloud services using infrastructure as code.
* Establish clear tagging, budgeting, cost allocation, and monitoring practices so cloud spending can be understood by project, environment, workload, and program activity.
* Continuously optimize cloud cost and performance through rightsizing, autoscaling, storage lifecycle policies, scheduling, caching, serverless or spot capacity, and other practical FinOps approaches.
* Support separate development, testing, staging, and production environments while maintaining reproducibility and minimizing unnecessary infrastructure expense.

**DevOps, Reliability, Security, and Operations**

* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, backend applications, data workflows, and analytical services.
* Containerize services and workflows using Docker and support orchestration through managed container platforms, Kubernetes, batch systems, or serverless services as appropriate.
* Implement logging, metrics, tracing, monitoring, alerting, backups, recovery procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Implement security controls (least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management) in alignment with CGS and Lincoln Institute security policy.
* Support the technical documentation, access controls, change records, data-handling practices, and other evidence needed for federal, partner, client, and Lincoln Institute requirements.
* Troubleshoot backend, performance, reliability, networking, permissions, data movement, and deployment issues across development and production environments.

**What You Will Need:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent professional experience in computer science, software engineering, information systems, engineering, geography, or a related technical field.
* 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or a closely related role.
* 5+ years of experience solving geospatial cloud architecture problems.
* 2+ years of experience successfully empowering and developing staff.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building production backend services, APIs, data platforms, or distributed systems using Python or another modern programming language.
* Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads in AWS, GCP, or other cloud platforms.
* Experience architecting data-intensive or compute-intensive systems that must process large volumes of data reliably and efficiently.
* Demonstrated experience with AWS services such as S3, Batch, ECS or EKS, Lambda, Step Functions, RDS or Aurora, API Gateway, IAM, and CloudWatch.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL, including data modeling, query optimization, and application integration; PostgreSQL or PostGIS experience is particularly relevant.
* Working knowledge of Esri enterprise GIS architectures, with the ability to support licensing decisions, enterprise deployments, and alignment of Esri products and user access with organizational needs.
* Working knowledge of geospatial data standards and architecture (e.g., OGC standards) and how they inform system design.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, containers, Linux, automated testing, deployment automation, and production monitoring.
* Working knowledge of cloud networking, identity and access management, secrets, storage, compute, databases, queues, APIs, and observability.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing and optimizing cloud performance and cost, including the ability to explain cost drivers and recommend practical improvements.
* Experience with Git/GitHub and collaborative software-development practices, including code review and technical documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, systems-thinking, and communication skills, including the ability to explain architecture, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.
* Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and external partners in a fast-moving, fully remote environment.
* U.S. Citizen, or legally authorized to work in the U.S. with no need for future sponsorship.

**Helpful Experience (Nice to Have):**

* Experience working with geospatial APIs and data interoperability standards such as pygeoapi
* Experience building backend systems for Earth observation, environmental modeling, raster processing, scientific computing, or other large-scale analytical workflows.
* Experience with workflow and data orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Argo, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with MLOps, model registries, experiment tracking, GPU workloads, distributed training, or scalable inference.
* Experience supporting government or federally funded programs and associated security, documentation, reporting, data-handling, or compliance requirements.
* Experience with metadata catalogs, data discovery systems, provenance, persistent identifiers, or interoperable data services.
* AWS certification or demonstrated experience with FinOps, disaster recovery, production incident management, or security architecture.
* Experience supporting government, nonprofit, consulting, or mission-driven technical projects.

**Compensation Overview**

The salary market range for this role is $96,000-$115,000 depending on level of education, years of experience, and other relevant qualifications. Please be sure to review our benefits overview below as the four-day workweek, 15% retirement, the Institute paying 90-95% of the medical plan costs and 100% the dental plan costs create a total compensation package for this role between $130,000 - $155,000 roughly. A member of HR would be happy to make a side-by-side comparison of your benefits to help with your assessment of this opportunity compared to others.

**How to Apply**

Please submit a cover letter and resume directly on the Lincoln Institute’s website. The cover letter should succinctly describe your interest in joining the CGS team; why you are qualified for the role; and what relevant expertise and experience you offer. Applications will be considered on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

**Our Benefits**

Include but are not limited to (a) 3x employer contribution towards retirement matching your employee contribution up to 15%, (b) health insurance, (c) dental insurance, (d) vision insurance, (e) 100% reimbursement of the health care deductible through a health reimbursement account, (f) short-term disability coverage, (g) long term disability coverage, (h) paid parental leave, (i) voluntary insurances such as accident insurance, (j) health care flexible spending, (k) dependent care flexible spending, (l) paid time off for holidays, vacation, personal, sick, bereavement, and jury duty, (m) office closure between December 24 – Jan 1 each calendar year, (n) flexible schedule and option for a compressed 4 day workweek, (o) tuition and staff development reimbursement, (p) pet insurance, and (q) Employee Assistance Program.

**Our Values**

Cooperation and Teamwork, Forthright Feedback, Initiative, Acceptance of Responsibility, Multicultural Sensitivity

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

The Lincoln Institute of Land Policy is dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment by hiring, training, promoting, and carrying out personnel procedures with respect to compensation, benefits, transfers, layoffs, or terminations, on the basis of individual merit, experience, and ability without regard to race (including traits historically associated with race such as hair texture, length of hair, protective hairstyles or cultural or religious headdresses), color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), ancestry, citizenship status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, military service, serious medical condition, expunged juvenile record, personal appearance, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, status as a victim, credit information, homelessness status, reproductive health decision making, or any other characteristic protected by law or otherwise.

**Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision**

Lincoln Institute of Land Policy will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

**Non-Smoking Organization**

Lincoln Institute of Land Policy is a Non-Smoking organization. Smoking and the use of tobacco products are prohibited at all times and on all property owned, leased, or under the control of Lincoln Institute of Land Policy at all times, including, but not limited to indoor and outdoor grounds, walkways and sidewalks, parking lots, company vehicles, and private vehicles parked on Lincoln Institute of Land Policy property.

**Company Overview**
====================

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

**Company Operating Rhythm**
============================

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

**Director of Product Operations**
==================================

Product Operations is the connective tissue of our product organization. As Director of Product Operations, you own the systems, cadences, and analysis that let product, engineering, program management, GTM, finance, and executive leadership operate off a single, trusted picture of what we are building, when it ships, and what it is worth.

This is a high-visibility role with broad surface area. You will run the new product introduction (NPI) process end to end, keep product deliverables on track across a distributed set of teams, quantify the revenue impact of roadmap decisions, coordinate deliverables owed to and from our partners, and prepare the material that leadership uses to steer the business. You will spend as much time building durable process and instrumentation as you do driving individual launches.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable running a cross-functional launch gate review, modeling ARR impact in a spreadsheet, and writing the one-page summary an executive reads before a board meeting.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Product Deliverable Coordination**

* Maintain a single source of truth for product commitments, milestones, dependencies, and status across all product lines
* Drive accountability for deliverables across product management, engineering, design, docs, support, and GTM — surfacing risk early rather than reporting it late
* Establish and enforce lightweight standards for PRDs, roadmap artifacts, release readiness, and launch documentation
* Identify and remove chronic sources of friction and rework in how the product organization plans and ships

### **New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own the end-to-end NPI process: stage gates, entry and exit criteria, readiness checklists, and go/no-go decision forums
* Chair launch readiness reviews and hold cross-functional owners to gate criteria across engineering, security, support, pricing, legal, marketing, and sales enablement
* Coordinate beta and early access programs, including participant selection, feedback capture, and exit criteria for GA
* Run post-launch retrospectives and drive the resulting process improvements into the next cycle
* Continuously improve NPI for speed and predictability — the process should scale with the company, not slow it down

### **Program Management Partnership**

* Partner closely with Program Management to align the product roadmap with engineering delivery plans, release trains, and capacity
* Reconcile roadmap commitments against actual delivery, and maintain a clear, honest view of schedule confidence
* Establish shared dependency tracking and escalation paths across product and engineering programs
* Ensure planning inputs — sizing, sequencing, staffing assumptions — are consistent between product plans and program plans

### **Financial and Revenue Impact Analysis**

* Build and maintain models that quantify the revenue impact of roadmap decisions: ARR opportunity, expansion and retention effects, competitive displacement, and pipeline influence
* Partner with Finance on product P&L inputs, cost-to-serve, pricing and packaging analysis, and business case development for major investments
* Support annual and quarterly planning with scenario analysis and resource allocation recommendations grounded in expected return
* Track realized outcomes against the business cases used to justify investment, and close the loop with leadership on what actually delivered
* Establish and maintain the product metrics framework — adoption, usage, attach, retention — and connect it to financial outcomes

### **Partner Deliverable Coordination**

* Coordinate deliverables owed to and from technology, ISV, channel, and strategic partners, including integration milestones, certification requirements, and co-launch commitments
* Track partner-facing roadmap commitments and ensure internal delivery plans reflect them
* Serve as the operational interface between the partner/BD organization and product and engineering teams
* Prepare partner-facing roadmap materials and support joint planning and QBR cycles

### **Cross-Functional Interface**

**Marketing**

* Partner with product marketing on launch tiering, messaging inputs, positioning reviews, and launch calendar sequencing across the portfolio
* Ensure roadmap and launch timing are reflected in demand gen, campaign, and event planning, and that marketing has the technical substance it needs early enough to build against
* Coordinate analyst relations and competitive inputs back into roadmap and business case work

**Sales**

* Maintain visibility into customer-facing roadmap commitments — what has been promised, to whom, by when, and whether an internal owner and delivery plan exist behind it
* Run the intake and triage process for feature requests, roadmap exceptions, and custom commitments tied to key pipeline opportunities, routing them to the right product owner and escalating to product and sales leadership when a decision is needed
* Flag commitments that are unbacked, at risk, or in conflict with the roadmap early enough for leadership to act, and track each one through to a decision
* Work with sales leadership to understand top pipeline deals and at-risk renewals, and translate deal-blocking product gaps into prioritized, quantified roadmap input
* Support strategic customer engagements: executive briefings, roadmap sessions under NDA, and design partner arrangements
* Partner with sales enablement to ensure the field is trained and equipped ahead of every launch, and that release readiness includes GTM readiness

**Support and Customer Success**

* Establish a standing channel with Support and CS to surface escalation themes, defect trends, and top customer pain points into product prioritization
* Participate in escalation review for critical customer issues, ensuring product and engineering ownership is clear and resolution is tracked to closure
* Track support-driven signals — ticket volume, deflection, time-to-resolution, escalation frequency — as inputs to roadmap and quality investment decisions
* Ensure support readiness (documentation, runbooks, staffing, tooling) is an enforced NPI gate criterion rather than an afterthought
* Close the loop with CS on adoption and health data for newly launched capabilities

### **Executive Support and Business Cadence**

* Own the weekly business review (WBR): agenda, data preparation, metric integrity, follow-ups, and closure on action items
* Prepare executive and board-level materials on product performance, roadmap status, launch readiness, and investment returns
* Support quarterly business reviews, planning cycles, and OKR setting and tracking for the product organization
* Act as a trusted advisor and force multiplier to the product leadership team — anticipating what leadership will need to decide and having the analysis ready before it is asked for
* Drive clarity and follow-through on cross-functional decisions and escalations

description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for ***#BetterGlobalHealth***. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024!

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing ***#BetterGlobalHealth*** to patients everyday!

  

**Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!**

The Senior Product Manager plays the pivotal role of an ambitious entrepreneur within the organization tasked with identifying lucrative market opportunities in the healthcare industry and designing innovative products to capitalize on those gaps. In this role, deep Health Care industry knowledge is the primary driver of success, and while specific technical knowledge is a significant advantage, market intuition takes precedence. You will work seamlessly across the product lifecycle, collaborating with all Smile stakeholders to successfully design, develop, market, sell, and implement our solutions. A critical component of this role involves partnering tightly with our Technical Product Managers—who handle day-to-day technical execution and delivery—to ensure strategic visions are transformed into highly scalable, interoperable realities.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Act as an ambitious entrepreneur with a start-up mentality to proactively identify unmet market opportunities within the healthcare space and design strategic product capabilities to capitalize on them.
* Collaborate with, and take direction from, the Director of Product Management to define and share ownership of the overarching product strategy and positioning for Smile’s platform components.
* Collaborate extensively with all Smile stakeholders—including engineering, sales, marketing, and leadership—to design, develop, market, sell, and implement new products effectively.
* Partner closely with Technical Product Managers to guide prioritization, provide market context, and translate business needs into actionable development backlogs.
* Conduct deep competitive research and market analysis to benchmark and identify key differentiators for specific platform capabilities.
* Support cross-functional teams and leaders in developing product communication materials (presentations, articles, white papers), product sales strategies, training, and internal/external demos.

description:
**About Scale Media**
---------------------

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition team and raise the bar on performance across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands.

We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers. You'll bring deep platform expertise and the drive to be in the numbers every day: reading performance, spotting what changed and why, and working with the team on what to do about it. You'll set the standard for how we buy media, make sure every platform gets clean, complete data, and make our media buyers sharper every week. You'll also allocate budget across channels against the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets we set.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be setting up campaigns or launching ads yourself, but you'll be in the accounts daily, diagnosing problems and helping make the calls on account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing. You'll work closely with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics, and help us build AI-enabled workflows that make our media buying faster and sharper.

You'll report to the VP of Growth.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Daily performance management.** Reviewing performance every day across brands and channels, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them.
* **Leading the paid acquisition team.** Managing and developing our media buyers: reviewing accounts with them, pressure-testing decisions, and building their judgment.
* **Media buying standards.** Setting and raising the bar on how we buy Meta and paid social: account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing.
* **Platform data quality.** Making sure we send the right data into every platform: pixels and Conversions API firing correctly, the right event parameters, and audience exclusions set up properly.
* **Landing pages, creative, and copy.** Working with media buyers, Creative, and Ecommerce to decide which pages to launch and where creative and copy need to improve.
* **Budget allocation.** Allocating and pacing budget across paid channels to hit the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets set with the VP of Growth.
* **Testing.** Running a structured test roadmap across audiences, offers, landing pages, and campaign settings, and turning results into clear next moves.
* **Performance reads.** Working with Analytics to read performance through MTA and lift testing, and acting on what the results show.
* **AI-enabled workflows.** Using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, creative tagging, and optimization.
* **Agencies and vendors.** Managing agency or vendor support where relevant.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level efficiency targets
* Scaled Meta and paid social spend across brands
* A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks
* Clean, consistent account structures that are easier to scale and diagnose
* Reliable platform data, with no pixel/CAPI event or audience gaps
* A media buying team that makes stronger decisions on its own
* Faster testing velocity, with a clear backlog and documented learnings
* A higher hit rate on new landing pages, creative, and copy

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **Deep Meta and paid social expertise.** You've personally managed 8-figure Meta spend for consumer brands, know the platform inside out, and have a playbook on how to scale without losing efficiency that adapts as the platform evolves.
* **Drive to be in the numbers every day.** You look at performance daily because you want to, you notice when something moves, and you don't rest until you understand and address it.
* **People leadership.** You've managed media buyers and made them measurably better through direct feedback, account reviews, and clear standards.
* **Tracking fluency.** You understand pixels, Conversions API, event parameters, and audience exclusions well enough to spot problems and specify fixes.
* **Cross-channel budget experience.** You've allocated budget across more than one paid channel and can make tradeoffs between them.
* **Conversion and creative judgment.** You can look at a landing page, ad, or piece of copy and say specifically what will improve performance.
* **Testing discipline.** You design clean tests, read results honestly, and know when a learning is real.
* **Analytical strength.** You're comfortable working through performance data, attribution gaps, and the limits of platform-reported numbers.
* **AI fluency.** You actively use AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution.
* **Cross-functional partnership.** You work well with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics without adding unnecessary process.
* **7–10 years of relevant experience, including managing media buyers.**

**Strong candidate backgrounds include:**

* Meta or paid social leads at scaled DTC brands
* Senior media buyers who have managed a team of buyers
* Agency paid social leads who've run large ecommerce accounts

**Preferred, but Not Required**

* Experience with TikTok or other paid social channels
* Hands-on Google Search, YouTube, and Performance Max experience
* Experience in supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription businesses
* Experience operating across multi-brand portfolios

**Company Description**

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life.  **Job Description**

The Vuori AI team is laying the foundation for the future of Vuori's AI ecosystem, building the platforms, tools, and frameworks that power AI-driven productivity, workflow automation, intelligent decision-making, and agentic implementations across the business. Our mission is to transform how work gets done by leveraging modern AI technologies, autonomous agents, and intelligent systems to solve real business problems, accelerate innovation, and create measurable impact at scale.

As Sr. Director of AI Architecture & Governance, you will serve as Vuori's senior-most technical authority on AI platform design, enterprise standards, and responsible AI. You will set the architectural direction for how AI systems are built and integrated across the organization, and establish the governance frameworks that ensure those systems are secure, compliant, scalable, and trustworthy.

This role calls for a rare combination of deep technical expertise and organizational leadership — someone who can engage at the level of system design with engineers while also shaping AI strategy with executive and business partners. You will work across teams and functions to raise the quality and consistency of AI development at Vuori, and put in place the standards and guardrails that let teams innovate with confidence.

**What you'll get to do:**

*Set direction and raise the bar*

* Shape the evolution of Vuori's enterprise AI architecture, ensuring it keeps pace with the growth of the business and the maturity of the AI ecosystem.
* Establish reference architectures, engineering standards, and integration patterns that teams across Vuori use when building AI systems.
* Lead technical evaluations of AI platforms, foundation models, cloud services, and tooling — recommending adoption decisions based on rigorous analysis of performance, cost, security, and fit.
* Raise the architectural capability of engineers across Vuori through design reviews, pairing, documentation, and reusable patterns others adopt because they are good.
* Bring clarity to complex, ambiguous problems — including calling out when a proposed AI approach is not the right solution.
* Make build-versus-buy-versus-partner recommendations that shape the AI platform for years, and communicate the rationale clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

*Build and maintain AI governance*

* Develop and operationalize Vuori's AI governance framework, covering model risk management, data privacy, bias detection, audit trails, and regulatory compliance.
* Establish AI engineering standards, security guardrails, testing and evaluation protocols, and responsible AI policies that apply consistently across all teams building AI systems.
* Create governance structures that give teams a clear path to building and shipping AI responsibly — balancing speed of innovation with enterprise-grade risk management.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Data teams to ensure AI systems meet applicable regulations, data handling requirements, and ethical standards.
* Implement ongoing monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement processes for AI systems in production.

*Partner across the organization*

* Work closely with senior technology and business leaders to align AI architecture and governance with organizational priorities and investment decisions.
* Serve as a clear, credible voice on AI architecture and risk in conversations with executive sponsors, engineering leadership, and external partners or auditors.
* Collaborate with AI product, engineering, and data teams to ensure architectural and governance requirements are understood and built in from the start — not added after the fact.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads through architectural guidance, design reviews, and the development of shared standards they can apply independently.

*Measure and evolve*

* Track and report on platform reliability, governance adherence, security posture, and the business impact of AI architecture investments.
* Continuously assess the AI landscape and incorporate emerging technologies, best practices, and industry standards to keep Vuori's AI ecosystem well-positioned.
* Use data and operational experience to refine standards, improve governance processes, and remove friction for teams building AI responsibly.

  
**Qualifications**

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of experience in software engineering or technology architecture, including 5+ years leading enterprise AI or data platform architecture at scale.
* Demonstrated experience designing and governing AI systems in production — including LLMs, agentic systems, ML pipelines, and model serving infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in enterprise AI governance, risk management, security, and compliance frameworks.
* Proven ability to develop and enforce technical standards and architectural principles across large, cross-functional engineering organizations.
* Experience with cloud-native architectures on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, and modern AI infrastructure patterns including RAG, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience building and deploying with frontier AI lab models, platforms, and/or frameworks (i.e. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, etc.).
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI architecture and governance requirements clearly to engineering, business, and executive audiences.
* Strong leadership presence and experience building alignment across a matrixed organization without direct authority over all stakeholders.
* Experience with enterprise AI governance platforms, model risk management frameworks, or AI regulatory standards such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF.
* Familiarity with MLOps, model lifecycle management, AI observability, and responsible AI tooling.
* Experience with low-code and pro-code enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or Google Gemini Enterprise.
* Background in retail, direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, or a similar consumer operating environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale architecture and governance programs in high-growth organizations.
* Active engagement with the broader AI and technology community through publications, speaking, or open-source contributions.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our investment in you:**

At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees:

* Health Insurance
* Savings and Retirement Plan
* Employee Assistance Program
* Generous Vuori Discount & Industry Perks
* Paid Time Off
* Wellness & Fitness benefits

The salary range for this role is $215,300 per year - $288,225 per year. This role is bonus eligible.

Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
